title: Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems
title_zh: 元反思进化有效提升了生产级人工智能系统

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM)-guided evolutionary optimization has successfully improved prompts, programs, and even entire AI systems. Most optimization methods select a candidate from the search frontier, then mutate it in one LLM pass based only on its failures. This focus on the frontier can stall on production AI systems, where isolated failures reveal little about complex, hidden interactions. We introduce CoCoEvolve ( Co rtex Co de Evolve ), an evolutionary optimizer built around what we call meta-reflection , wherein an agentic mutator (Cortex Code) selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. We apply CoCoEvolve to optimize three classes of production AI systems: data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows. On DABStep, CoCoEvolve tops the public leaderboard, reaching 92.8% held-out hard accuracy compared to 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA under matched conditions. Across six LLM data pipeline workloads, it outperforms every evaluated baseline. On data-eng-bench, CoCoEvolve lifts test-set solve rate from 59.1% to 77.4%, past the best baseline of 73.6%. It also has 11pp higher accuracy than GEPA on HotpotQA while remaining competitive with specialized optimizers on established mathematical and systems benchmarks. Matched ablations confirm that each component of CoCoEvolve contributes to these gains, demonstrating the value of meta-reflection for optimizing production AI systems.

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as semantic mutation operators: given a candidate prompt or program and evaluation feedback for that candidate, an LLM proposes a revised candidate. This approach, exemplified by evolutionary optimizers like AlphaEvolve and OpenEvolve, has led to breakthrough improvements in prompts, algorithms, and other text-based artifacts because LLMs can make semantically meaningful changes that conventional random mutation cannot ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Sharma, 2025 ) . However, most LLM-guided evolutionary optimizers select a single parent, use its failures to propose a new candidate in one LLM call, and only then evaluate the result.

This parent-local, one-shot interface is effective when the failure makes both the defect and its repair apparent. It falls short for production AI systems, where isolated failures can reveal little about interacting causes and relevant evidence may be distributed across the search history. First, the selected parent’s failure may not reveal the root cause, and a locally beneficial edit may regress capabilities elsewhere in the search history. Second, the mutator cannot interact with the target environment, test hypotheses, or revise its candidate in response to intermediate results. Search can consequently trade one solved task for another, revisit exhausted strategies, or end up plateauing ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .

We introduce CoCoEvolve ( Co rtex Co de Evolve ), an evolutionary optimizer built around meta-reflection : (i) selectively retrieving evidence from the accumulated search history beyond the selected parent’s failure and (ii) actively probing the target environment while constructing and validating a mutation. To support meta-reflection, CoCoEvolve uses Cortex Code as its coding-agent mutator ( Snowflake Inc., 2026b ) . The mutator can inspect the parent, run focused experiments, revise its implementation, and validate the result before committing a child. It accesses evolutionary history through both a compact summary and structured queries, allowing it to retrieve prior programs that solved a specific task, inspect the mutation that restored a lost capability, or identify related tasks that have historically regressed together.

Figure 1 illustrates meta-reflection for a DABStep data agent ( Egg et al., 2025 ) , where payment-processing rules must be inferred across documentation and live data. Here, a one-shot, parent-local mutation doesn’t make progress, whereas CoCoEvolve’s meta-reflective mutation retrieves the missing evidence, validates the corresponding repair, and succeeds. The same behavior repeats with Lockpicking with Interference , a synthetic stress test where every leading baseline plateaus below perfect accuracy within 50 iterations, while CoCoEvolve reaches 100% in 6 iterations (Appendix G.1 ).

We evaluate CoCoEvolve primarily on production AI systems, where correctness depends on interactions with live systems rather than prompt text alone. These include agent specifications coupled to tools and semantic data models, SQL pipelines that invoke LLMs to process textual data ( Liskowski et al., 2025 ) , and data-engineering workflows ( dbt Labs, 2026 ) . We additionally evaluate standard prompt, mathematical, and systems optimization benchmarks from prior work to test whether the method remains competitive when interaction with the environment is limited or unnecessary.

CoCoEvolve optimizes an agent specification on DABStep ( Egg et al., 2025 ) , reaching 92.8% held-out hard accuracy, versus 78.4% for an interactive Meta-Harness baseline and 30.4% for GEPA ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026b ) ; it also tops the validated public leaderboard. 1 1 1 At submission, this score has not been externally validated; we have contacted the DABStep maintainers but have not received a response. CoCoEvolve also improves over the strongest evaluated baseline on six LLM-powered data processing pipeline workloads by up to 10 pp. On held-out HotpotQA, it gains 11 pp over GEPA and 43 pp over the seed ( Yang et al., 2018 ; Agrawal et al., 2026b ) . On data engineering, it achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated evolutionary methods and leads on held-out data-eng-bench ( Snowflake AI Research, 2026 ) , solving 77.4% of tasks. Across mathematical and systems optimization objectives, it is competitive with leading evolutionary methods such as AdaEvolve ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) , with the largest improvements occurring on objectives that exhibit extended search plateaus. Matched ablations confirm that each component of CoCoEvolve contributes to these gains.

We introduce CoCoEvolve, an evolutionary optimizer built around meta-reflection (Section 2.2 ). Figure 2 summarizes its evolutionary loop and Algorithm 1 in Appendix C specifies it in full. Our implementation instantiates the coding-agent mutator with Cortex Code.

paragraphs.en: We define meta-reflection as reasoning beyond one parent’s observations by selectively retrieving historical evidence from the accumulated search history and actively acquiring feedback from the target environment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将元反思定义为：通过从累积的搜索历史中选择性地检索历史证据，并主动获取目标环境的反馈，从而超越单个父智能体的观察范围进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Formally, a meta-reflective mutator receives two complementary inputs. First, a compact context bundle c t c_{t} , curated from the search history, is injected directly into the mutator’s prompt. Second, an environment ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} provides tools that the mutator invokes on demand. It augments a base environment ℰ 0 ⊆ ℰ \mathcal{E}_{0}\subseteq\mathcal{E} of execution, validation, and target-system tools with selective access to the search history.
paragraphs.zh: 正式而言，一种元反思式变异器接收两个互补的输入。 首先，一个从搜索历史中精心挑选的紧凑上下文包 c t c_{t} 被直接注入到变异器的提示中。 其次，一个环境 ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} 提供工具，变异器可根据需要调用这些工具。 它在一个包含执行、验证和目标系统工具的基环境 ℰ 0 ⊆ ℰ \mathcal{E}_{0}\subseteq\mathcal{E} 的基础上，增加了对搜索历史的选择性访问权限。

paragraphs.en: In CoCoEvolve, these interface components take the following concrete forms.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CoCoEvolve 中，这些接口组件具有以下具体形式。

paragraphs.en: Ledger to gauge stagnation. CoCoEvolve’s Curate \mathrm{Curate} operator constructs a compact ledger of recent strategies and their outcomes (Appendix C.1 ). The agent uses this ledger to assess stagnation and choose whether to continue the current strategy, adopt a newly proposed one, or revert to undirected mutation. AdaEvolve makes a related search-level decision through a fixed trigger, invoking tactic generation when improvement falls below a threshold ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) . CoCoEvolve instead lets the same class of model that performs mutation reason over concurrently tracked strategies and make this decision from the search trajectory, without a hand-tuned stagnation trigger.
paragraphs.zh: 记录簿用于衡量停滞状态。 CoCoEvolve 的 Curate \mathrm{Curate} 算子会构建一个包含近期策略及其结果的紧凑型记录簿（附录 C.1）。 智能体利用该记录簿评估是否出现停滞，并决定是继续当前策略、采用新提出的策略，还是回归无方向突变。 AdaEvolve 则通过一个固定触发机制做出类似的搜索层面决策：当改进程度低于某一阈值时，便会调用策略生成机制（Cemri et al., 2025）。 CoCoEvolve 则让执行突变的同一类模型，基于同步追踪的策略进行推理，并从搜索轨迹中自主做出这一决策，而无需手动设定停滞触发机制。

paragraphs.en: Live environment interaction. The base environment ℰ 0 \mathcal{E}_{0} provides domain-specific tools for execution, testing, and target-system queries. For example, in mathematical and systems optimization, ℰ 0 \mathcal{E}_{0} exposes scratch runners that reveal syntax and execution errors. In DABStep agent optimization, it provides tools for SQL execution, scratch-agent deployment, target-question tests, and deployment checks. This feedback lets the agent diagnose and repair failures before committing a child to outer-loop evaluation. Appendix C.2 specifies the interfaces, and Appendix D.2 compares static, edit-only agentic, and self-validating mutation.
paragraphs.zh: 实时环境交互。 基础环境 ℰ₀ \mathcal{E}_{0} 提供用于执行、测试和目标系统查询的领域特定工具。 例如，在数学和系统优化中，ℰ₀ \mathcal{E}_{0} 会暴露临时运行器，以揭示语法和执行错误。 在 DABStep 智能体优化中，它提供用于 SQL 执行、临时智能体部署、目标问题测试和部署检查的工具。 这种反馈使智能体能够在将子智能体提交至外层循环评估之前，诊断并修复故障。 附录 C.2 详细说明了接口，附录 D.2 比较了静态、仅编辑型智能体和自我验证突变模式。

paragraphs.en: Tools to query interlinked history. Beyond these domain capabilities, Augment \mathrm{Augment} forms ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} by adding on-demand tools that selectively query the interlinked program archive as evidence is needed. These tools expose per-task lineage: which program first solved a task, whether a later mutation lost that capability, and which tasks tend to co-regress. The agent can therefore retrieve the exact diff that last restored a lost capability or vet a candidate child against known co-regressions before committing. Appendix C.2 and Table 6 specify the complete query interface, while Appendix D.3 isolates the contributions of the injected ledger and history-query tools.
paragraphs.zh: 用于查询相互关联历史的工具。 除了这些领域能力之外，Augment \mathrm{Augment} 通过按需添加工具来构建 ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t}，这些工具会在需要证据时选择性地查询相互关联的程序存档。 这些工具揭示了每个任务的谱系：哪个程序首次解决了某个任务、后续变异是否失去了该能力，以及哪些任务倾向于共同退化。 因此，智能体可以检索出最后恢复已丢失能力的确切差异，或在最终确定之前，根据已知的共同退化情况对候选子程序进行验证。 附录 C.2 和表 6 详细说明了完整的查询接口，而附录 D.3 则单独分析了注入的账本和历史查询工具所做出的贡献。

paragraphs.en: After validation, we return the generated child p t p_{t} to the outer search loop, where f f scores it, ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} records it, and the search policy governs archive admission and subsequent parent selection.
paragraphs.zh: 验证后，我们将生成的子个体 p t p_{t} 返回到外层搜索循环，其中 f f 对其进行评分，ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} 将其记录，而搜索策略则控制存档的接纳及随后的父代选择。

paragraphs.en: By default, CoCoEvolve uses standard MAP-Elites parent selection ( Sharma, 2025 ; Mouret & Clune, 2015 ) . For objectives scored over a pool of questions or test cases, we introduce a novel budgeted ℓ p \ell^{p} roster that prioritizes complementary coverage; Appendix C.5 defines it, and Appendix D.1 compares it with MAP-Elites, best-only selection, and pareto-frontier sampling.

paragraphs.en: Beyond parent selection, an optional similarity-informed task-selection policy uses proxy scores to reduce evaluation cost and focus mutation on high-information tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 除了亲本选择之外，一种可选的基于相似性的任务选择策略会利用代理分数来降低评估成本，并将变异集中在信息量高的任务上。

paragraphs.en: Similarity-guided sparse evaluation and observation curation. Prior methods typically expose the mutator to observations from a random task minibatch. When the task pool V V is large or individual evaluations are costly, however, exhaustively scoring every candidate is impractical. On DABStep, for example, each agent query takes roughly 3–10 minutes, so scoring the full 300-question search pool requires 15–50 agent-hours before parallelism. At the same time, tasks need not be independent: a repair that equips a candidate to solve one task may transfer to other tasks requiring the same capability. This motivates sparse, targeted evaluation: score a bounded subset, infer likely performance on the remaining tasks, and direct the next mutation toward an unresolved target with broad expected transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 基于相似性的稀疏评估与观察筛选。 以往的方法通常让变异体接触来自随机任务小批量的观察数据。 然而，当任务池 V V 规模较大或单次评估成本高昂时，对每个候选体进行全面评分是不切实际的。 例如，在 DABStep 上，每次智能体查询大约需要 3–10 分钟，因此要对包含 300 道题的完整搜索池进行评分，在并行处理之前需要消耗 15–50 个智能体小时。 同时，任务之间未必相互独立：一个使候选体能解决某项任务的修复方案，可能也能迁移到需要相同能力的其他任务中。 这促使我们采用稀疏且有针对性的评估方法：仅对有限子集进行评分，推断其在剩余任务上的潜在表现，并将下一次变异引导至一个具有广泛预期迁移效果的未解决目标。

paragraphs.en: Major enterprise platforms increasingly deploy fully managed agentic frameworks inside the data perimeter ( Snowflake Inc., 2026a ; Databricks, 2024 ; Amazon Web Services, 2023 ) . These agents iteratively decompose requests and use intermediate results to orchestrate semantic data access, unstructured retrieval, sandboxed code execution, and custom APIs. Although the platform hides infrastructure and state management, reliability depends on the instructions, tool interfaces, and data models that guide this reasoning, making each a target for optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 主要企业平台正越来越多地在数据边界内部部署完全托管的智能体框架（Snowflake Inc., 2026a；Databricks, 2024；Amazon Web Services, 2023）。 这些智能体会迭代分解请求，并利用中间结果来协调语义数据访问、非结构化检索、沙盒代码执行和自定义 API。 尽管平台隐藏了基础设施和状态管理，但其可靠性取决于指导这一推理过程的操作指令、工具接口和数据模型，因此每一项都成为优化的目标。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We formulate agent optimization as searching over agent specifications p ∈ 𝒫 p\in\mathcal{P} encompassing system prompts, tool schemas, and planning instructions to maximize end-to-end success across diverse user queries on tables and unstructured documents containing domain knowledge. We evaluate on DABStep, a benchmark of 450 payment-processing questions requiring multi-step reasoning over more than nine join dimensions and wildcard joins. The setting is challenging: the original authors report only 14.55% accuracy for state-of-the-art agents. Starting from the same agent specification, we run CoCoEvolve, GEPA, and Meta-Harness for 100 iterations and compare performance on both the held-out set and the validated public leaderboard. Because evaluations are costly, CoCoEvolve uses information-gain guided observation curation (Section 2.3 ) to direct its budget toward likely failures with broad neighborhood reach. Appendix F.1 details this instantiation.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们将智能体优化问题表述为搜索智能体规格 p ∈ 𝒫（p∈𝒫），该规格涵盖系统提示、工具模式和规划指令，以在包含领域知识的表格和非结构化文档中，针对多样化的用户查询实现端到端的最大成功率。 我们在 DABStep 上进行评估，这是一个包含 450 个支付处理问题的基准数据集，这些问题需要在超过九个连接维度和通配符连接上进行多步推理。 该设置颇具挑战：原始作者报告称，当前最先进的智能体在此任务上的准确率仅为 14.55%。 我们从相同的智能体规格出发，运行 CoCoEvolve、GEPA 和 Meta-Harness 各 100 次迭代，并在预留数据集和经过验证的公开排行榜上比较其性能。 由于评估成本高昂，CoCoEvolve 采用以信息增益为指导的观察筛选方法（第 2.3 节），将其资源预算集中用于可能失败且对邻近样本具有广泛影响的情况。 附录 F.1 详细说明了这一具体实现。

sents.zh: 在匹配度不足的分片和预算条件下，CoCoEvolve 的表现优于 GEPA 和 Meta-Harness，即使后者配备了可提供相当程度预提交验证覆盖范围的自我验证和自我测试工具（附录 F.1）；三种机制可以解释这种差距。

paragraphs.en: Live environment interaction grounds mutation in execution feedback. DABStep intentionally tests domain rules whose downstream implications must be inferred or composed across documentation and data, a failure mode emphasized by the benchmark authors ( Egg et al., 2025 ) . The live environment turns this ambiguity from guesswork into testable hypotheses. The Cortex Code mutator repeatedly formed fee interpretations, tested them through live SQL against a known merchant total, and revised its diagnosis. This live feedback exposed two hidden logic errors and enabled a verified vectorized fee engine, producing the run’s largest single gain, from 28 to 95 correct answers (Appendix F.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 实时环境中的交互为执行反馈中的变异提供了依据。 DABStep 有意测试那些下游影响必须通过文档和数据进行推断或组合的领域规则，这种失效模式得到了基准测试作者（Egg 等人，2025）的强调。 实时环境将这种模糊性从猜测转化为可验证的假设。 Cortex Code 变异器反复生成费用解释，通过实时 SQL 与已知的商户总额进行验证，并修正其诊断结果。 这种实时反馈暴露出两个隐藏的逻辑错误，并促成了一个经过验证的向量化费用引擎，实现了本次运行中最大的单次收益提升，正确回答数从 28 增至 95（附录 F.4）。

paragraphs.en: Curated environment tools compress otherwise lengthy investigations. The base environment exposes scripts, managed skills, and developer tools that encode reusable investigation and validation workflows, allowing the mutator to invoke proven procedures instead of reconstructing them across mutation cycles. During the fee-engine revision, the mutator first checked its raw SQL, then used an existing testing skill to deploy the draft as a live scratch agent and exercise multiple question families as self-validation before commit. Each passed in a single tool call, whereas the prior specification failed after roughly 40 tool calls, allowing the mutator to invest its budget in structural reasoning rather than verification plumbing (Appendix C.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Structural changes are more robust than prompt changes. Reflective prompt evolution is effective ( Agrawal et al., 2026b ) , but a single model call over preassembled evidence offers no path to explore and validate changes to the underlying tool architecture. In a matched DABStep run, GEPA revised the instructions but left the default single-row fee calculator tool unchanged. Its evolved agent therefore aggregates 26 transaction fees through 26 tool calls and asks the LLM to sum the outputs in context, producing arithmetic drift such as 19.51 instead of 19.36. Such remedies require live environment interaction: inspecting schemas, executing draft SQL, and validating outputs against known totals before commit. By testing structural edits in situ, CoCoEvolve discovered two independently verified remedies: a vectorized fee-engine stored procedure and a dynamic table that materializes per-transaction fees for downstream SQL aggregation. These solutions shift computation from fallible in-context arithmetic into deterministic system components, illustrating how coding-agent mutation can advance where prompt-only search plateaus (Appendix F.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 结构变更比提示词变更更具稳健性。 反思式提示词演化是有效的（Agrawal 等，2026b），但仅通过一次模型调用处理预组装的证据，无法提供探索并验证底层工具架构变更的路径。 在一次匹配的 DABStep 运行中，GEPA 修改了说明，但保留了默认的單行费用计算器工具不变。 因此，其演化后的智能体通过 26 次工具调用累计了 26 笔交易费用，并要求 LLM 在上下文中对结果求和，从而产生了算术偏差，例如得出 19.51 而非 19.36。 此类补救措施需要与实时环境进行交互：在提交前检查模式、执行草案 SQL，并将输出与已知总数进行验证。 通过在原位测试结构编辑，CoCoEvolve 发现了两个独立验证的解决方案：一个向量化的费用引擎存储过程和一个动态表，后者可为下游 SQL 聚合生成每笔交易的费用。 这些解决方案将计算从易出错的上下文内算术运算转移到了确定性的系统组件中，表明编码智能体的突变如何能在仅依赖提示词搜索陷入停滞时推动进展（附录 F.4）。

paragraphs.en: Modern cloud data platforms expose AI functions , declarative SQL operators that embed LLM inference inside query engines for row-wise tasks such as generation, classification, and extraction ( Liskowski et al., 2025 ; Databricks, 2023 ; Microsoft, 2024 ) . Industry workloads compose these operators with common table expressions (CTEs) and joins into multi-stage pipelines, so reliability depends jointly on prompts, output schemas, and pipeline topology. For instance, a pipeline may first use a generation function to identify personally identifiable information (PII) spans and define a JSON schema, then pass this plan to a downstream function that performs contextual redaction. We therefore search over executable SQL programs p ∈ 𝒫 p\in\mathcal{P} , allowing CoCoEvolve to restructure both LLM prompts and operator composition for diverse row distributions, missing data, and edge cases.
paragraphs.zh: 现代云数据平台提供了 AI 功能，即声明式 SQL 算子，这些算子将 LLM 推理嵌入查询引擎中，用于逐行任务（如生成、分类和提取）（Liskowski 等，2025；Databricks，2023；Microsoft，2024）。 行业工作负载通过公共表表达式（CTE）和连接操作将这些算子组合成多阶段流程，因此其可靠性同时取决于提示词、输出模式和流程拓扑结构。 例如，一个流程可能首先使用生成函数识别个人身份信息（PII）片段并定义 JSON 模式，然后将此计划传递给下游函数以执行上下文相关的信息删除。 因此，我们在可执行的 SQL 程序 p ∈ 𝒫 中进行搜索，允许 CoCoEvolve 针对不同的行分布、缺失数据和边界情况重构 LLM 提示词和算子组合。

paragraphs.en: Setup. Each task starts from a minimal SQL program p 0 p_{0} containing one generative AI-function call, which the mutator may rewrite into a multi-stage, multi-operator pipeline. Lockpicking with Interference (Appendix G.1 ) scores exact match on 50 labeled six-digit strings governed by a hidden ruleset. Beyond this synthetic diagnostic, we evaluate classification on Reddit comments ( go_emotions ) and lengthy legal documents ( lex_glue ) ( Demszky et al., 2020 ; Chalkidis et al., 2022 ) . We also study financial numerical reasoning : finqa requires multi-step arithmetic over tables and prose, while convfinqa distributes such reasoning across a dialogue ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ) . Finally, multilexnorm requires normalizing noisy, nonstandard social-media tokens into canonical forms ( van der Goot et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 每个任务都从一个最小的 SQL 程序 p₀（p_{0}）开始，该程序包含一个生成式 AI 函数调用，而变异器可以将其重写为多阶段、多操作符的流程。 “干扰下的锁芯破解”（附录 G.1）在由隐藏规则集管理的 50 个带标签的六位数字符串上实现了完全匹配。 除了这项合成诊断测试外，我们还对 Reddit 评论（go_emotions）和冗长的法律文件（lex_glue）进行了分类评估（Demszky 等人，2020；Chalkidis 等人，2022）。 我们还研究了金融数值推理：finqa 需要在表格和文本中进行多步骤算术运算，而 convfinqa 则将这些推理分布在对话中（Chen 等人，2021；Chen 等人，2022）。 最后，multilexnorm 要求将嘈杂且非标准的社交媒体标记规范化为标准形式（van der Goot 等人，2021）。

The mutator can instead execute candidate pipelines and repair syntax, schema, or engine-specific failures before committing, which is especially valuable for brittle SQL programs. Results. Table 2 shows that CoCoEvolve outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline on all six tasks across classification, numerical reasoning, text normalization, and rule discovery. The largest gains are a 10 pp improvement that exactly recovers Lockpicking’s hidden rules and a 7.7 pp gain on multilexnorm , whose intermingled, context-dependent normalization patterns echo the latent-rule challenge isolated by Lockpicking.

paragraphs.en: On-demand history queries help escape local minima. When a highly coupled objective plateaus, reasoning only over the current parent’s failures may not expose a route out. AdaEvolve’s adaptive scheduler illustrates this limitation on Lockpicking ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) : it first reaches 90% at iteration 34; over the remaining 16 iterations, two stagnation-triggered paradigm generations propose targeted worked examples and exhaustive condition matrices for the five residual failures, yet its best score never moves. CoCoEvolve reaches exact recovery at iteration 6, before AdaEvolve’s first paradigm generation at iteration 10, by using on-demand history tools to query evidence across lineages rather than repeatedly reframing the same residual errors (Appendix G.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 按需历史查询有助于摆脱局部最小值。 当高度耦合的目标函数出现平台期时，仅基于当前父节点的失败进行推理可能无法揭示突破路径。 AdaEvolve 的自适应调度器在 Lockpicking（Cemri 等人，2025）中展示了这一局限性：它在第 34 次迭代时首次达到 90%；在接下来的 16 次迭代中，两次因停滞而触发的范式生成提出了针对五个剩余失败问题的定向练习示例和详尽的条件矩阵，但其最佳得分始终未变。 CoCoEvolve 在第 6 次迭代时就实现了完全恢复，早于 AdaEvolve 在第 10 次迭代时的首次范式生成；这是因为它使用了按需历史工具来跨谱系查询证据，而不是反复重新表述相同的剩余错误（附录 G.1）。

paragraphs.en: Self-validation prevents wasted mutation cycles. Without a cheap validator, mutation can waste substantial search budget on SQL programs that never execute. On go_emotions , GEPA repeatedly placed LATERAL FLATTEN inside a UDF; because each compiler error collapsed to a zero score without diagnostic feedback, broken variants consumed up to 71% of the budget. Alternatives such as OpenEvolve mitigate evaluation cost with cascading evaluators that stop after compilation failure, but each rejected candidate still consumes an evolutionary iteration ( Sharma, 2025 ) . CoCoEvolve instead executes drafts on a cheap sample and repairs syntax failures within the same multi-turn mutation before commit. Self-validation thus converts compiler errors from terminal scores into actionable context, reserving outer-loop evaluation for executable programs.
paragraphs.zh: 自我验证可防止突变周期被浪费。 如果没有一个低成本的验证器，突变可能会在那些从未执行的 SQL 程序上浪费大量搜索预算。 在 go_emotions 上，GEPA 反复将 LATERAL FLATTEN 置于 UDF 内部；由于每次编译器错误都会在没有诊断反馈的情况下归零得分，因此有缺陷的变体消耗了高达 71% 的预算。 其他方法（如 OpenEvolve）通过级联评估器来降低评估成本——这些评估器在编译失败后便会停止，但每个被拒绝的候选体仍然会消耗一次进化迭代（Sharma, 2025）。 CoCoEvolve 则会在一个低成本样本上执行草案，并在提交前于同一轮多步突变中修复语法错误。 因此，自我验证将编译器错误从终结性得分转化为可操作的上下文，从而将外层循环的评估保留给可执行的程序。

sents.en: Self-validation prevents wasted mutation cycles.
sents.zh: 自我验证可防止突变周期被浪费。

sents.en: On go_emotions , GEPA repeatedly placed LATERAL FLATTEN inside a UDF; because each compiler error collapsed to a zero score without diagnostic feedback, broken variants consumed up to 71% of the budget.
sents.zh: 在 go_emotions 上，GEPA 反复将 LATERAL FLATTEN 置于 UDF 内部；由于每次编译器错误都会在没有诊断反馈的情况下归零得分，因此有缺陷的变体消耗了高达 71% 的预算。

sents.en: Alternatives such as OpenEvolve mitigate evaluation cost with cascading evaluators that stop after compilation failure, but each rejected candidate still consumes an evolutionary iteration ( Sharma, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 其他方法（如 OpenEvolve）通过级联评估器来降低评估成本——这些评估器在编译失败后便会停止，但每个被拒绝的候选体仍然会消耗一次进化迭代（Sharma, 2025）。

sents.en: CoCoEvolve instead executes drafts on a cheap sample and repairs syntax failures within the same multi-turn mutation before commit.
sents.zh: CoCoEvolve 则会在一个低成本样本上执行草案，并在提交前于同一轮多步突变中修复语法错误。

sents.en: Self-validation thus converts compiler errors from terminal scores into actionable context, reserving outer-loop evaluation for executable programs.
sents.zh: 因此，自我验证将编译器错误从终结性得分转化为可操作的上下文，从而将外层循环的评估保留给可执行的程序。

paragraphs.en: Data engineering is the process of transforming raw warehouse data into trusted, queryable models. Agents often fail to construct or repair transformations due to challenges in managing the relevant context, such as data warehouse details, implicit relationships, and domain-specific business rules. We optimize over context-curation pipeline specifications p ∈ 𝒫 p\in\mathcal{P} that govern the creation of a context-grounded knowledge graph (KG) and a suite of executable adherence tests derived from it, both of which are supplied to a downstream agent prior to executing a transformation. We evaluate on data-eng-bench ( Snowflake AI Research, 2026 ) , a data-engineering benchmark comprising 103 tasks over an enterprise warehouse with 579 tables, 19 business schemas, and more than 8,000 columns.
paragraphs.zh: 数据工程是将原始仓库数据转化为可信且可查询模型的过程。 智能体常常因难以管理相关上下文（例如数据仓库细节、隐式关系和领域特定的业务规则）而无法构建或修复转换流程。 我们对上下文整理流程规范 p ∈ 𝒫（p∈𝒫）进行优化，这些规范负责生成一个基于上下文的知识图谱（KG）以及由此衍生的一系列可执行的合规性测试；在执行转换之前，这两者都会被提供给下游智能体。 我们在 data-eng-bench（Snowflake AI Research, 2026）上进行了评估，这是一个数据工程基准测试，包含在一个拥有 579 张表、19 个业务架构和超过 8,000 个列的企业级仓库中执行的 103 项任务。

The mutator may refine the prompt, introduce new skills, contribute to existing ones, or reorganize the pipeline into a multi-agent protocol. Φ \Phi is evaluated through a two-stage process: the mutator evolves the upstream pipeline p p while the downstream agent remains fixed; a score is produced only after the agent consumes the generated KG, iterates over the corresponding adherence tests, and implements the transformation that is scored by the benchmark’s verifier. paragraphs.en: Analysis. Meta-reflection preserves globally relevant skills. During evolution, an earlier lineage introduced a skill to resolve a recurring dbt configuration error. A later hillclimb on an unrelated target dropped the skill. When the failure re-appeared, CoCoEvolve’s mutator retrieved the archived mutation plan via the ledger that first named the fix and re-implemented the skill, rather than re-deriving it from scratch. We observe that the mutator matches returning failures against past resolutions in the evolution ledger, linking current errors to the earlier mutations that fixed them. Meta-reflection thus allows for capabilities the search has already learned to remain visible to the mutator even when not directly present in the parent’s trace.
paragraphs.zh: 分析。 元反思保留了全局相关的技能。 在演化过程中，一个较早的谱系引入了一项技能，用以解决一个反复出现的 dbt 配置错误。 之后对某个无关目标进行的一次 hillclimb 操作去除了这项技能。 当该故障再次出现时，CoCoEvolve 的变异器通过账本检索了最初命名该修复方案的存档变异计划，并重新实现了这项技能，而不是从头开始重新推导。 我们观察到，变异器会将重复出现的故障与演化账本中的过往解决方案进行匹配，从而将当前错误与之前解决这些错误的变异关联起来。 因此，元反思使得搜索过程已经学到的能力即使在父代的轨迹中未直接体现时，也能继续被变异器识别。

paragraphs.en: These experiments ask whether CoCoEvolve can match specialized optimizers on established mathematical and systems benchmarks and whether its benefits persist on HotpotQA, AIME, and IFBench from GEPA’s benchmark suite when live interaction is unavailable. Within each task, all arms share the task definition, initial artifact, backbone, evaluator, and data split where applicable, enabling matched end-to-end comparisons across executable programs and prompt-only systems.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验旨在探究 CoCoEvolve 是否能在成熟的数学和系统基准测试中与专用优化器相媲美，以及当实时交互不可用时，其优势在 GEPA 基准套件中的 HotpotQA、AIME 和 IFBench 上是否依然有效。 在每个任务中，所有分支都共享任务定义、初始产物、主干结构、评估器和数据划分（如适用），从而能够在可执行程序和仅提示的系统之间进行匹配的全局比较。

paragraphs.en: Setup. On math and systems tasks, each evaluator returns one scalar for the complete program. CoCoEvolve uses a lightweight reflector to detect stagnation and decide whether to continue, request a new direction, or revert to undirected mutation. When a new direction is needed, a distinct proposer queries techniques from any lineage while preserving the mutator’s turn for implementation. Appendix E specifies the complete reflector-proposer protocol and prompts. AIME and IFBench use GPT-5.6-luna because Sonnet-5 saturates AIME at the seed, leaving no optimization signal. The main table omits standard deviations for readability; bold and underlining mark the best and second-best results within each backbone, with ties sharing marks. Appendix I reports standard deviations, while Appendix J.1 details the prompt protocol.

paragraphs.en: Results. Table 4 reports the mathematical and ADRS systems benchmarks. CoCoEvolve is best or tied best in 25 of 44 Avg/Best cells, including 13 of 24 math and 12 of 20 ADRS cells, more than any other method. On Sonnet-5, the largest gains occur on plateau-prone Signal Processing, TXN, and Heilbronn Convex; on Signal Processing, CoCoEvolve reaches 0.766 0.766 versus AdaEvolve’s 0.747 0.747 . Gaps largely vanish on saturated objectives, while mixed GPT-5.6-terra results show that the advantage depends on the backbone. Appendix I.3 analyzes plateau escape, structural family switching, and saturation controls task by task. Table 5 reports prompt optimization, where CoCoEvolve leads GEPA and the seed on every HotpotQA and IFBench split, while AIME is inconsistent under repeated evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Analysis. Across the mathematical and systems benchmarks, CoCoEvolve recovers the gains of AdaEvolve’s specialized three-level adaptive controller through meta-reflection over the search history, offering a more flexible route to stagnation-aware search.
paragraphs.zh: 分析。 在数学和系统基准测试中，CoCoEvolve 通过对搜索历史的元反思，重现了 AdaEvolve 专用三级自适应控制器的性能提升，为感知停滞的搜索提供了更灵活的路径。

sents.en: Across the mathematical and systems benchmarks, CoCoEvolve recovers the gains of AdaEvolve’s specialized three-level adaptive controller through meta-reflection over the search history, offering a more flexible route to stagnation-aware search.
sents.zh: 在数学和系统基准测试中，CoCoEvolve 通过对搜索历史的元反思，重现了 AdaEvolve 专用三级自适应控制器的性能提升，为感知停滞的搜索提供了更灵活的路径。

paragraphs.en: The strategy ledger turns plateaus into new search directions. On Signal Processing, the global best remained at 0.7534 for 26 iterations even though the current parent and champion represented distinct Savitzky-Golay and Butterworth filter families. Reasoning over the strategy ledger, the lightweight reflector recognized a population-wide plateau and requested a new proposal rather than another local mutation or crossover. Using on-demand history queries to identify what the search had not tried, the separate proposer found an orthogonal family: an L1 trend filter formulated as a linear program. The mutator implemented this paradigm and raised the score to 0.7745 in one iteration. This trace illustrates how the strategy ledger and on-demand history tools separate stagnation detection, paradigm selection, and implementation: the search history reveals not only which ideas succeeded, but which structural alternatives remain unexplored.

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary Harnesses. LLM-guided evolutionary optimization shifts improvement from training-time parameter updates toward inference-time search, using LLMs as semantic mutation operators over prompts, algorithms, and programs. Building on quality-diversity search ( Mouret & Clune, 2015 ) , systems such as FunSearch, AlphaEvolve, and OpenEvolve apply this paradigm to scientific and algorithmic discovery ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Sharma, 2025 ) . GEPA enriches mutation with language-valued execution traces that expose reasoning, tool calls, outputs, and errors beyond scalar rewards ( Agrawal et al., 2026b ) . Subsequent work broadens the optimized artifact space through unified declarative APIs ( Agrawal et al., 2026a ) , allocates search adaptively ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Lange et al., 2025 ) , and standardizes outer harnesses ( Ursekar et al., 2026 ) . For prompts and LM pipelines, EvoPrompt and Promptbreeder evolve prompts with LLM-driven operators ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Fernando et al., 2024 ) , MIPROv2 jointly searches instructions and demonstrations for multi-stage programs ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024 ) , and TextGrad backpropagates natural-language feedback through compound systems ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2025 ) . These methods generally retain a parent-local, one-shot mutation interface in which the harness preselects evidence and evaluates the proposed edit only after generation. Promptbreeder also evolves its mutation prompts, whereas CoCoEvolve changes the mutation interface itself through meta-reflection over the search history and target environment. Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) similarly uses a coding-agent proposer with filesystem access to prior traces; CoCoEvolve combines compact curated context with structured, on-demand queries over evolutionary history and a live environment.
paragraphs.zh: 进化框架。 由大型语言模型（LLM）引导的进化优化将改进重点从训练时的参数更新转向推理时的搜索，利用 LLM 作为提示、算法和程序的语义变异算子。 基于质量多样性搜索（Mouret & Clune, 2015），FunSearch、AlphaEvolve 和 OpenEvolve 等系统将此范式应用于科学和算法发现（Romera-Paredes et al., 2024；Novikov et al., 2025；Sharma, 2025）。 GEPA 通过语言值执行轨迹增强变异，这些轨迹揭示了超出标量奖励的推理过程、工具调用、输出和错误（Agrawal et al., 2026b）。 后续研究通过统一的声明式 API（Agrawal et al., 2026a）扩展了可优化的产物空间，实现了自适应搜索分配（Cemri et al., 2025；Lange et al., 2025），并标准化了外层框架（Ursekar et al., 2026）。 在提示和语言模型流程方面，EvoPrompt 和 Promptbreeder 使用 LLM 驱动的算子进化提示（Guo et al., 2025；Fernando et al., 2024），MIPROv2 联合搜索多阶段程序的指令和演示（Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024），而 TextGrad 则通过复合系统反向传播自然语言反馈（Yuksekgonul et al., 2025）。 这些方法通常保留父个体局部、单次变异的接口，其中框架会预先选择证据，并在生成之后才评估所提议的编辑。 Promptbreeder 还会进化其变异提示，而 CoCoEvolve 则通过搜索历史和目标环境的元反思来改变变异接口本身。 Meta-Harness（Lee et al., 2026）同样使用一个具有文件系统访问权限的编码智能体提案器来调用历史轨迹；CoCoEvolve 则将精简的精选上下文与针对进化历史和实时环境的结构化按需查询相结合。

paragraphs.en: Context Curation Approaches. The efficacy of LLM agents relies heavily on rich, domain-specific context, such as organizational schemas ( Döhmen et al., 2026 ) or dynamically constructed failure taxonomies ( Cojocaru et al., 2026 ) . Recent frameworks automate context engineering by treating contexts as evolving playbooks ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) or co-evolving curation skills alongside artifacts ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . CoCoEvolve applies this principle to the optimization trajectory itself, distilling accumulated search history into a compact ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文策展方法。 LLM 智能体的有效性在很大程度上依赖于丰富的领域特定上下文，例如组织架构（Döhmen 等，2026）或动态构建的失败分类体系（Cojocaru 等，2026）。 近期的框架通过将上下文视为不断演化的策略手册（Zhang 等，2026），或在生成成果的同时协同演化策展技能（Ye 等，2026），实现了上下文工程的自动化。 CoCoEvolve 将这一原则应用于优化轨迹本身，将累积的搜索历史提炼为一份紧凑的记录簿。

paragraphs.en: Limitations of Evolutionary Approaches. AI-driven evolutionary frameworks exhibit systematic vulnerabilities, including hidden regressions ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , overfitting to the initial task set under continual learning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and context costs that grow with the accumulated archive ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . CoCoEvolve addresses these failure modes with bounded, queryable access to historical co-regressions, helping the optimizer avoid cycling through brittle solutions that break previously solved cases.
paragraphs.zh: 进化方法的局限性。 由人工智能驱动的进化框架存在系统性脆弱性，包括隐藏的回退（Zhou 等人，2026）、在持续学习中对初始任务集过度拟合（Wang 等人，2026），以及随累积档案增长的情境成本（Lee 等人，2026）。 CoCoEvolve 通过受限制且可查询的历史协同回退访问机制来解决这些失效模式，从而帮助优化器避免在脆弱的解决方案中循环，而这些方案会破坏先前已解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: We present CoCoEvolve, an evolutionary optimizer for production AI systems. By both probing the environment and querying an evolutionary ledger and prior lineages, CoCoEvolve’s mutator extends parent-local reflection into meta-reflection over the search process, enabling it to diagnose failures, reconstruct hidden mechanisms, preserve complementary discoveries, and verify structural revisions before committing. Across domains, our results suggest that the combination of curating selected historical evidence, providing on-demand tools for probing the live environment and evolutionary history, and using a coding-agent mutator to reason over both offers an effective path to improving the prompts, code, tools, data models, and pipelines of real-world AI systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CoCoEvolve，这是一种用于生产级人工智能系统的进化优化器。 通过同时探测环境、查询进化账本和先前的谱系，CoCoEvolve 的变异器将父代局部反思扩展为对搜索过程的元反思，使其能够诊断故障、重构隐藏机制、保留互补的发现，并在最终确定前验证结构修订。 跨多个领域，我们的结果表明，结合精选历史证据的整理、按需提供用于探测实时环境和进化历史的工具，以及使用编码智能体变异器对两者进行推理，为改进真实世界人工智能系统的提示、代码、工具、数据模型和流程提供了一条有效路径。

paragraphs.en: This appendix is organized as follows. Appendix C specifies the evolutionary loop (Appendix C.1 ), the history-query and workspace tools (Appendix C.2 ), the similarity-graph InfoGain branch used by agent evolution (Appendix C.3 ), the experimental hyperparameters (Appendix C.4 ), and the budgeted ℓ p \ell^{p} roster (Appendix C.5 ). Appendix D reports parent selection, mutation and self-validation, history access, and similarity-manifold targeting ablations. The history-access study includes Signal Processing and DABStep. Each ablation subsection reports its trial count and score provenance. Appendix E records the mutator, reflector, and proposer prompts. Appendix F gives the DABStep protocol, analyzes Meta-Harness’s post-improvement churn, and presents an evolved agent instruction. Appendix G presents the Lockpicking synthetic diagnostic (Appendix G.1 ) and describes the AI-function experiments and their evolved artifacts. Appendix H describes the data-engineering pipeline, its evaluation, and an evolved artifact. Appendix I records math and ADRS evaluator settings and the detailed result tables (Appendix I.2 ). Appendix I.3 gives the per-task analysis: which methods lead each cell, then Heilbronn Convex, Circle Packing, Cloudcast, and TXN traces (Figures 4 – 7 ). paragraphs.en: Section 2.3 writes a generic similarity kernel κ \kappa . This section applies to the DABStep agent-evolution setting, which evaluates a program on many instances and maintains a similarity graph over that pool. Math, ADRS, and Signal Processing have no such pool and skip this channel, even though Signal Processing still exposes per-signal query tools (Table 7 ). We precompute an embedding-similarity matrix κ \kappa on V V , with values in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . DABStep specializes the estimator in Section 2.3 by replacing κ ⁡ ( τ , τ ′ ) \kappa(\tau,\tau^{\prime}) with κ ​ ( τ , τ ′ ) 4 \kappa(\tau,\tau^{\prime})^{4} in both the numerator and denominator, giving more weight to nearby tested instances. After each mutation, a local success or regression update refines the estimate. Estimates for untested coordinates are capped at 0.7 0.7 , and coordinates with observed failures are floored at 0.1 0.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 第 2.3 节编写了一个通用的相似性核函数 κ \kappa。 本节适用于 DABStep 智能体演化设置，该设置在多个实例上评估程序，并在此实例池中维护一个相似性图。 Math、ADRS 和 Signal Processing 没有这样的实例池，因此跳过此通道，尽管 Signal Processing 仍然提供每个信号的查询工具（表 7）。 我们在 V V 上预计算嵌入相似性矩阵 κ \kappa，其值域为 [0,1]。 DABStep 通过将在分子和分母中都将 κ ⁡ ( τ , τ ′ ) \kappa(\tau,\tau^{\prime}) 替换为 κ ​ ( τ , τ ′ ) 4 \kappa(\tau,\tau^{\prime})^{4}，对第 2.3 节中的估计器进行了专门优化，从而赋予邻近的已测试实例更大的权重。 每次突变后，局部成功或退化的更新会进一步精确该估计值。 未测试坐标的估计值上限为 0.7，而观察到失败的坐标则下限设为 0.1。

sents.en: Section 2.3 writes a generic similarity kernel κ \kappa .

paragraphs.en: Marginal coverage alone can under-allocate mutations to valuable specialists. Suppose most programs solve the same large set of easy dimensions, while different programs solve only one or two distinct hard dimensions. paragraphs.en: We test whether useful parent selection requires both preserving complementary capabilities and directing mutations toward programs that can consolidate them. The frontier and roster draw from all islands. Table 8 compares the complete setups on each task.

paragraphs.en: These selectors use different evidence to identify useful parents. select-best spends every mutation on the current incumbent, leaving complementary capabilities in other programs unused. map-elites preserves programs in distinct grid cells, but those cells need not correspond to distinct solved instances. pareto-frontier uses per-instance wins, yet win-count weighting does not discount wins already represented by another parent. The greedy ℓ p \ell^{p} roster instead retains a program only while it adds uncovered instances, then favors roster members with larger exclusive contributions. The ℓ p \ell^{p} roster has the highest observed held-out score on both tasks in Table 8 , consistent with allocating mutations by complementary coverage rather than grid diversity alone.
paragraphs.zh: 这些选择器使用不同的证据来识别有用的父程序。select-best 将每次变异都用于当前最优程序，导致其他程序中互补的能力未被利用。map-elites 保留位于不同网格单元中的程序，但这些单元不必对应于不同的已解决实例。pareto-frontier 使用每个实例的获胜次数，但获胜次数的加权方式并未对已被另一个父程序代表的获胜次数进行折扣。 贪心 ℓ p \ell^{p} 名单则仅在程序能增加未覆盖的实例时才会保留它，然后优先选择具有更大专属贡献的名单成员。 在表 8 的两项任务中，ℓ p \ell^{p} 名单的观察到的保留分数最高，这与根据互补覆盖而非仅基于网格多样性来分配变异的做法一致。

paragraphs.en: The exponent sweep probes how to allocate mutations after complementary parents have entered the roster. Flatter weighting spends more turns on small-marginal specialists; quadratic weighting concentrates ordinary mutations on parents that already contribute many distinct solves, giving later edits more opportunities to consolidate those capabilities. The p = 2 p=2 row leads on both validation and held-out test, consistent with a balance between consolidation pressure and specialist access. The dip at p = 1.5 p=1.5 shows that the effect is not simply monotonic in p p : changing the weighting changes which lineages receive repeated edits, and those search paths can produce different final programs.
paragraphs.zh: 指数扫描探究了在互补亲本进入名单后如何分配突变。 更平坦的权重分配会花更多轮次处理边际效益小的专家智能体；二次权重则会将普通突变集中在那些已贡献许多不同解决方案的亲本上，从而为后续编辑提供更多整合这些能力的机会。 p = 2 的行在验证和保留测试集上均表现最佳，这与整合压力与专家智能体获取之间的平衡一致。 p = 1.5 处的下降表明，该效应并非简单地随 p 单调变化：权重的改变会影响哪些谱系获得重复编辑，而这些搜索路径可能产生不同的最终程序。

sents.en: The exponent sweep probes how to allocate mutations after complementary parents have entered the roster.
sents.zh: 指数扫描探究了在互补亲本进入名单后如何分配突变。

sents.en: Flatter weighting spends more turns on small-marginal specialists; quadratic weighting concentrates ordinary mutations on parents that already contribute many distinct solves, giving later edits more opportunities to consolidate those capabilities.
sents.zh: 更平坦的权重分配会花更多轮次处理边际效益小的专家智能体；二次权重则会将普通突变集中在那些已贡献许多不同解决方案的亲本上，从而为后续编辑提供更多整合这些能力的机会。

sents.en: The p = 2 p=2 row leads on both validation and held-out test, consistent with a balance between consolidation pressure and specialist access.
sents.zh: p = 2 的行在验证和保留测试集上均表现最佳，这与整合压力与专家智能体获取之间的平衡一致。

sents.en: The dip at p = 1.5 p=1.5 shows that the effect is not simply monotonic in p p : changing the weighting changes which lineages receive repeated edits, and those search paths can produce different final programs.
sents.zh: p = 1.5 处的下降表明，该效应并非简单地随 p 单调变化：权重的改变会影响哪些谱系获得重复编辑，而这些搜索路径可能产生不同的最终程序。

paragraphs.en: This ablation separates two benefits of an interactive mutator: editing the current candidate with access to its environment, and testing that candidate before committing it. The first can support broad instruction-level fixes; the second is especially useful for changes to executable code or dependent objects.
paragraphs.zh: 这种剥离方法区分了交互式变异器的两种优势：在访问其环境的同时编辑当前候选项，以及在最终确定该候选项之前对其进行测试。 第一种优势可以支持广泛的指令级修正；而第二种优势对于可执行代码或依赖对象的修改尤其有用。

paragraphs.en: We run this ablation on Heilbronn Convex ( N = 13 N{=}13 ) and DABStep. Within each task, the three arms share the parent policy, population and island settings, feature grid, history-access interface, iteration budget, targeting configuration, and reflector/proposer configuration. They differ in the mutator’s action space. Heilbronn Convex has no instance similarity graph; DABStep keeps its similarity graph enabled across all three arms. The reflector/proposer remains on in every arm, matching the published configurations. A1 ( static mutator ) is one LLM completion over the parent, ledger, and active paradigm; it cannot inspect the workspace or execute anything. A2 ( agentic, no candidate testing ) can edit the candidate and query history through evo.py , but cannot execute the edited candidate before committing it. A3 ( full mutator , published) adds pre-commit execution: a local Python sweep on Heilbronn Convex, or deployment and end-to-end testing of the edited agent on DABStep. On DABStep, A1 can only diagnose from injected artifacts, A2 can additionally query the database but cannot deploy the edited agent, and A3 has the complete query, deployment, and testing interface.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Heilbronn Convex（N = 13 N{=}13）和 DABStep 上运行了这项消融研究。 在每个任务中，三个分支共享父策略、种群和岛屿设置、特征网格、历史访问接口、迭代预算、目标配置以及反射器/提议器配置。 它们的不同之处在于变异器的动作空间。 Heilbronn Convex 没有实例相似性图；DABStep 在所有三个分支中都保持相似性图启用状态。 反射器/提议器在每个分支中均保持启用，这与已发布的配置一致。 A1（静态变异器）是在父策略、账本和当前范式基础上的一次 LLM 补全操作；它无法检查工作区或执行任何操作。 A2（智能体模式，无候选测试）可以通过 evo.py 编辑候选方案并查询历史，但无法在提交前执行已编辑的候选方案。 A3（完整变异器，已发布）增加了提交前的执行步骤：在 Heilbronn Convex 上进行本地 Python 扫描，或在 DABStep 上部署并端到端测试已编辑的智能体。 在 DABStep 上，A1 只能通过注入的工件进行诊断；A2 还可以查询数据库，但无法部署已编辑的智能体；而 A3 拥有完整的查询、部署和测试接口。

paragraphs.en: We report three Sonnet-5 trials per Heilbronn Convex arm. One trial stopped after 83 iterations; the others ran for 100. Its score is included in the reported summary, so that arm’s mean is not based on three equal-budget trials. One 100-iteration trial is reported per arm on DABStep. All DABStep Train/Test values are fresh full-pool re-evaluations of each arm’s champion rather than in-run estimates based on limited evaluations; A1’s initial estimate used a 25-question bootstrap sample. A1 never advanced past the first evaluation gate, so its champion is the unmodified seed also reported in Table 1 and as A1 in Table 13 . A3 on both tasks reuses the published champion rather than a new run; the DABStep champion is also the C3 arm in Table 13 . Each Δ \Delta is the raw-count difference from A1.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了每个 Heilbronn Convex 分支的三次 Sonnet-5 试验。 一次试验在 83 次迭代后停止；其余试验均运行了 100 次。 其得分被包含在报告的摘要中，因此该分支的平均值并非基于三次预算相等的试验得出。 在 DABStep 上，每个分支报告了一次 100 次迭代的试验。 所有 DABStep 训练/测试值均为每个分支冠军模型的全新完整池重评估，而非基于有限评估的运行时估计；A1 的初始估计使用了 25 道题的自助样本。 A1 从未通过第一次评估关卡，因此其冠军模型是未经修改的种子模型，该模型也报告在表 1 中，并在表 13 中列为 A1。 两个任务中的 A3 均复用已发布的冠军模型，而非运行新的试验；DABStep 的冠军模型也是表 13 中的 C3 分支。 每个 Δ \Delta 是相对于 A1 的原始计数差异。

Performance improves monotonically from the static mutator (A1), to agentic editing without pre-commit candidate testing (A2), to the full mutator (A3) on both tasks. paragraphs.en: Heilbronn Convex shows that the A1-to-A2 improvement is not explained by broader exploration: both arms attempt a similar range of strategies. The difference is how those ideas are incorporated. A1 frequently replaces large portions of the solver; in one matched trial, roughly one quarter of its scored edits regress and another third have no effect. A2 generally preserves the existing solver and adds components around it, reducing regressions to about one in eight, although it learns whether an edit worked only after evolutionary evaluation. A3 can test proposed changes through scratch execution and regresses on roughly 4 % 4\% of scored edits across the trials. Agentic editing therefore helps preserve prior functionality, while self-validation turns more of the budget into measured refinement.
paragraphs.zh: Heilbronn Convex 表明，从 A1 到 A2 的改进并非源于更广泛的探索：两种智能体都尝试了相似范围的策略。 差异在于这些思路是如何被整合的。 A1 经常替换求解器的较大部分；在一次匹配试验中，其约四分之一的计分编辑出现退化，另有三分之一没有效果。 A2 通常保留现有求解器，并在其周围添加组件，使退化情况减少到大约八分之一，尽管它只有在进化评估之后才能判断某项编辑是否有效。 A3 可以通过从头执行来测试拟议的更改，并且在所有试验中，约 4% 的计分编辑出现退化。 因此，智能体式编辑有助于保留先前的功能，而自我验证则能将更多预算转化为可量化的优化。

paragraphs.en: DABStep reveals why the relative gains differ across tasks. A1 sometimes identifies real instruction problems from injected context, but cannot inspect the database or run the revised agent. A2 can query the database, allowing it to correct fee-rule enumeration; the same accepted edit also tightens the response contract for exact-match answers. Because both changes affect many questions, they raise train/test accuracy from 33.7 % / 31.3 % 33.7\%/31.3\% to 67.3 % / 65.3 % 67.3\%/65.3\% . This closes roughly 55 % 55\% of the A1-to-A3 gap, compared with about 22 % 22\% on Heilbronn Convex. A3 additionally deploys and tests the edited agent, allowing it to validate a structural replacement for the fee-computation procedure and reach 95.3 % / 91.3 % 95.3\%/91.3\% . Thus, database-grounded editing can capture broad instruction-level improvements, whereas executable-code and dependent-object rewrites benefit most from end-to-end validation.
paragraphs.zh: DABStep揭示了不同任务中相对增益存在差异的原因。 A1有时能从注入的上下文中识别出真实的指令问题，但无法检查数据库或运行修改后的智能体。 A2可以查询数据库，从而能够纠正费用规则的枚举；同样被接受的编辑也收紧了对精确匹配答案的响应约束。 由于这两项改动都影响了大量问题，它们将训练/测试准确率从33.7 % / 31.3 % 提升至67.3 % / 65.3 %。 这填补了A1与A3之间差距的大约55 %，而在Heilbronn Convex上这一比例约为22 %。 A3还进一步部署并测试了经过编辑的智能体，使其能够验证费用计算流程的结构化替代方案，并将准确率提升至95.3 % / 91.3 %。 因此，基于数据库的编辑能够捕捉到广泛的指令层面改进，而可执行代码和依赖对象的改写则最能从端到端验证中受益。

paragraphs.en: We test two ways to give the mutator access to earlier search: a short ledger injected into each turn and structured tools for retrieving prior programs and traces. The four arms compare each mechanism alone and both together on Signal Processing and DABStep.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试了两种方法，让变异器能够访问早期的搜索过程：一种是在每一轮中注入一个简短的账本，另一种是提供结构化的工具来检索先前的程序和痕迹。 在信号处理和 DABStep 任务上，这四种机制分别单独测试，也进行了联合测试。

sents.en: We test two ways to give the mutator access to earlier search: a short ledger injected into each turn and structured tools for retrieving prior programs and traces.
sents.zh: 我们测试了两种方法，让变异器能够访问早期的搜索过程：一种是在每一轮中注入一个简短的账本，另一种是提供结构化的工具来检索先前的程序和痕迹。

sents.en: The four arms compare each mechanism alone and both together on Signal Processing and DABStep.
sents.zh: 在信号处理和 DABStep 任务上，这四种机制分别单独测试，也进行了联合测试。

paragraphs.en: The selected parent’s code and evaluation are available in every arm; this ablation changes access to other programs’ history. B1 ( parent-only ) receives no additional history. B2 ( ledger-only ) receives recent approaches, score changes, stagnation information, and the active paradigm in its prompt, but cannot fetch prior programs or traces. B3 ( tools-only ) can request earlier programs, lineage, scores, and thinking traces through evo.py , but receives no ledger. B4 ( full ) has both mechanisms. All four arms use Sonnet-5 for 100 iterations with the same population, islands, evaluator, and model-facing mutation budget. The evolution graph and reflector/proposer are off throughout. B4 therefore uses the published Signal Processing history-access interface without the reflector/proposer.
paragraphs.zh: 所选父智能体的代码和评估结果在所有分支中均可用；这种消融方法会改变对其他程序历史的访问权限。 B1（仅父智能体）不会收到任何额外的历史数据。 B2（仅账本）会在提示词中收到近期方法、分数变化、停滞信息以及当前范式，但无法获取先前的程序或轨迹。 B3（仅工具）可以通过 evo.py 请求早期程序、谱系、分数和思考轨迹，但不会收到任何账本数据。 B4（完整）同时具备这两种机制。 所有四个分支均使用 Sonnet-5 进行 100 次迭代，且种群、岛屿、评估器和面向模型的突变预算均相同。 演化图和反射器/提议器全程处于关闭状态。 因此，B4 使用的是已发布的信号处理历史访问接口，而不包含反射器/提议器。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 reports the best overall_score reached in one trial per arm.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 报告了每个分支在一次试验中达到的最佳 overall_score。

paragraphs.en: Scores rise from 0.6614 0.6614 for B1 to 0.7074 0.7074 with the ledger alone (B2) and 0.7487 0.7487 with tools alone (B3). B4, with both mechanisms, reaches 0.7681 0.7681 . Thus each mechanism helps relative to parent-only in these runs, and the combination scores highest. The B4 score is near the published Sonnet-5 mean of 0.7656 0.7656 (best 0.7841 0.7841 ), although the reflector/proposer is disabled in this ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用账本（B2）时，分数从 B1 的 0.6614 0.6614 提升至 0.7074 0.7074；仅使用工具（B3）时，分数为 0.7487 0.7487。 同时使用两种机制的 B4 达到了 0.7681 0.7681。 因此，在这些运行中，每种机制相较于仅使用父机制的情况都有帮助，而组合方案得分最高。 B4 的分数接近已发布的 Sonnet-5 平均值 0.7656 0.7656（最佳值为 0.7841 0.7841），尽管在此消融实验中反射器/提议器已被禁用。

B4, with both mechanisms, reaches 0.7681 0.7681 .
sents.zh: 同时使用两种机制的 B4 达到了 0.7681 0.7681。

paragraphs.en: The four final Signal Processing programs use different filtering designs. B1 combines a quadratic ridge-trend filter with a noise-adaptive moving average. B2’s champion describes an adaptive Kalman filter. B3 adds Rauch–Tung–Striebel backward smoothing to a Kalman filter. B4 combines Kalman and Savitzky–Golay smoothing with a median prefilter and slope-hysteresis logic.
paragraphs.zh: 四个最终的信号处理程序采用了不同的滤波设计。 B1 将二次岭趋势滤波器与噪声自适应移动平均相结合。 B2 的冠军方案描述了一种自适应卡尔曼滤波器。 B3 在卡尔曼滤波器中加入了 Rauch–Tung–Striebel 反向平滑技术。 B4 将卡尔曼滤波和 Savitzky–Golay 平滑技术与中值预滤波器及斜率滞后逻辑相结合。

sents.en: The four final Signal Processing programs use different filtering designs.
sents.zh: 四个最终的信号处理程序采用了不同的滤波设计。

sents.en: B1 combines a quadratic ridge-trend filter with a noise-adaptive moving average.
sents.zh: B1 将二次岭趋势滤波器与噪声自适应移动平均相结合。

sents.en: B2’s champion describes an adaptive Kalman filter.
sents.zh: B2 的冠军方案描述了一种自适应卡尔曼滤波器。

sents.en: B3 adds Rauch–Tung–Striebel backward smoothing to a Kalman filter.
sents.zh: B3 在卡尔曼滤波器中加入了 Rauch–Tung–Striebel 反向平滑技术。

sents.en: B4 combines Kalman and Savitzky–Golay smoothing with a median prefilter and slope-hysteresis logic.
sents.zh: B4 将卡尔曼滤波和 Savitzky–Golay 平滑技术与中值预滤波器及斜率滞后逻辑相结合。

paragraphs.en: The inspected winning turns illustrate how the interfaces are used. B1, with no access to other attempts, proposes a larger-window Savitzky–Golay filter and Holt smoothing, tests both, rejects them, and keeps a small parameter change. B3 first queries the best programs, recent scores, and lineage, then verifies a refinement of its Kalman/smoothing filter with local score sweeps. B4 recognizes a plateau of more than thirty iterations, queries high-scoring and diverse programs, and uses a local parameter sweep to find an improvement at a narrow threshold boundary. The B4 turn shows the ledger’s broad progress summary and targeted history lookup being used in the same edit.
paragraphs.zh: 经过检验的获胜步骤展示了这些接口是如何被使用的。 B1 无法访问其他尝试，因此提出了一种窗口更大的 Savitzky–Golay 滤波器和 Holt 平滑法，对两者进行了测试并予以拒绝，最终保留了一个较小的参数调整。 B3 首先查询了最佳程序、近期得分和谱系，然后通过局部得分扫描验证了其卡尔曼/平滑滤波器的改进版本。 B4 识别出超过三十次迭代后出现的平台期，查询了高分且多样化的程序，并利用局部参数扫描在狭窄的阈值边界上找到了改进点。 B4 的步骤展示了账本中广泛的进展摘要与目标历史查询在同一编辑中被同时使用。

paragraphs.en: DABStep uses the same four ledger/history-tool settings as Signal Processing. Its evolution graph and reflector/proposer remain enabled in every arm. The graph selects target questions on the controller side, while this ablation changes the history visible to the mutator; turning the graph off would change a second part of the loop. The reflector/proposer also stays fixed across arms. For B1 and B2, the core evo.py history commands and the task-specific get_performance , get_suggested_questions , and get_artifacts history commands are removed. B3 and B4 retain them. All four arms keep the six commands used to inspect and test the current candidate: query , test_agent , analyst_query , check_deploy , execute_sql , and test_draft .
paragraphs.zh: DABStep 使用了与信号处理相同的四个账本/历史工具设置。 其演化图和反射器/提议器在所有分支中均保持启用状态。 该图在控制器端选择目标问题，而此消融研究改变了突变器可见的历史记录；关闭该图则会改变循环的第二个部分。 反射器/提议器在所有分支中也保持固定不变。 对于 B1 和 B2，核心的 evo.py 历史命令以及任务特定的 get_performance、get_suggested_questions 和 get_artifacts 历史命令已被移除。B3 和 B4 则保留了这些命令。 所有四个分支都保留了用于检查和测试当前候选者的六个命令：query、test_agent、analyst_query、check_deploy、execute_sql 和 test_draft。

paragraphs.en: We report one primary 100-iteration Sonnet-5 trial per arm. Each champion is freshly scored on all 300 training and 150 held-out test questions. B4 reuses the published flagship champion. A second B4 run is discussed below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了每个分支一次主要的 100 次迭代 Sonnet-5 试验。 每个冠军模型都针对全部 300 道训练问题和 150 道预留的测试问题进行了重新评分。 B4 重用了已发布的旗舰冠军模型。 第二个 B4 运行将在下文讨论。

sents.zh: 我们报告了每个分支一次主要的 100 次迭代 Sonnet-5 试验。

sents.en: Each champion is freshly scored on all 300 training and 150 held-out test questions.
sents.zh: 每个冠军模型都针对全部 300 道训练问题和 150 道预留的测试问题进行了重新评分。

paragraphs.en: The four primary runs show a different pattern from Signal Processing. Ledger-only B2 scores below parent-only B1 on both train ( 210 210 versus 234 234 ) and test ( 99 99 versus 116 116 ). Tools-only B3 is only slightly above B1 ( 242 242 train and 119 119 test). Full B4 reaches 286 286 on train and 137 137 on test, the highest result in this comparison. On DABStep, the large observed gain appears when both history-access mechanisms are enabled; neither mechanism alone shows a comparable gain. This is the central result of the DABStep four-arm table.
paragraphs.zh: 四次主要运行显示出与信号处理不同的模式。 仅使用账本的 B2 在训练集（210 对比 234）和测试集（99 对比 116）上的得分均低于仅使用父项的 B1。 仅使用工具的 B3 仅略高于 B1（训练集 242，测试集 119）。 完整的 B4 在训练集上达到 286，在测试集上达到 137，是本比较中的最高结果。 在 DABStep 上，当两种历史访问机制同时启用时，才会出现显著的性能提升；单独使用任一机制都无法获得类似提升。 这是 DABStep 四臂实验表的核心结果。

sents.en: The four primary runs show a different pattern from Signal Processing.
sents.zh: 四次主要运行显示出与信号处理不同的模式。

sents.en: Ledger-only B2 scores below parent-only B1 on both train ( 210 210 versus 234 234 ) and test ( 99 99 versus 116 116 ).
sents.zh: 仅使用账本的 B2 在训练集（210 对比 234）和测试集（99 对比 116）上的得分均低于仅使用父项的 B1。

sents.en: Tools-only B3 is only slightly above B1 ( 242 242 train and 119 119 test).
sents.zh: 仅使用工具的 B3 仅略高于 B1（训练集 242，测试集 119）。

sents.en: Full B4 reaches 286 286 on train and 137 137 on test, the highest result in this comparison.
sents.zh: 完整的 B4 在训练集上达到 286，在测试集上达到 137，是本比较中的最高结果。

sents.en: On DABStep, the large observed gain appears when both history-access mechanisms are enabled; neither mechanism alone shows a comparable gain.
sents.zh: 在 DABStep 上，当两种历史访问机制同时启用时，才会出现显著的性能提升；单独使用任一机制都无法获得类似提升。

sents.en: This is the central result of the DABStep four-arm table.
sents.zh: 这是 DABStep 四臂实验表的核心结果。

paragraphs.en: The B1 and B2 traces show that discovering a useful fix does not guarantee it survives search. Both arms repeatedly identify a seed instruction that lists only five merchants from an older dataset version. For an unlisted merchant, the seed can answer “Not Applicable” without calling a tool, even though the current data contains thirty valid merchants. B1 repairs the instruction, and its assigned target question also improves, so the edit enters the surviving lineage. B2 makes and tests the same kind of repair in its first iteration, but its assigned target is unrelated to the merchant bug; the evaluation gate rejects the edit, and later candidates still inherit the stale instruction.
paragraphs.zh: B1 和 B2 的追踪结果表明，发现一个有用的修复方案并不保证该方案能存活于搜索过程中。 两条分支都反复识别出一个种子指令，该指令仅列出了旧版数据集中仅有的五个商家。 对于未列出的商家，种子指令无需调用工具即可回答“不适用”，尽管当前数据中包含了三十个有效商家。 B1 修复了该指令，其分配的目标问题也随之得到改善，因此这次编辑进入了存活谱系。 B2 在第一次迭代中也进行了同类修复并进行了测试，但其分配的目标与商家错误无关；评估机制拒绝了这次编辑，后续候选方案仍然继承了过时的指令。

paragraphs.en: The ledger gives the mutator a live-updated record of earlier approaches and projected scores. Its score column is revised as the similarity mechanism estimates full-pool performance, so a ledger value can differ from the program’s immediate measured result. In one traced case, a program scored 0.1767 0.1767 on its immediate evaluation but later appeared in the ledger at 0.4011 0.4011 . B1 sees no such history table. B2 receives the changing projections on every turn but cannot retrieve the earlier programs and traces needed to judge what a high-scoring entry actually does. The ledger-only arm is therefore exposed to uncertain historical scores without a way to check the underlying work, which helps explain its weaker result. B3 and B4 can inspect that work through their history tools.
paragraphs.zh: 该账本为修改器提供了先前方法的实时更新记录以及预测得分。 随着相似性机制对完整池性能进行估算，其得分列也会随之修订，因此账本中的数值可能与程序即时测得的结果存在差异。 在一个被追踪的案例中，某程序在即时评估中的得分为 0.1767 0.1767，但后来在账本中显示为 0.4011 0.4011。 B1 并未看到这样的历史记录表。 B2 每次都会接收到不断变化的预测结果，但却无法获取先前程序与追踪记录，因而无从判断一个高分条目实际上执行了哪些操作。 因此，仅依赖账本的分支在缺乏验证底层工作成果的方式下，面临着不确定历史得分的风险，这也有助于解释其结果为何较弱。 B3 和 B4 可以通过它们的历史记录工具来检查这些工作成果。

sents.en: B2 receives the changing projections on every turn but cannot retrieve the earlier programs and traces needed to judge what a high-scoring entry actually does.
sents.zh: B2 每次都会接收到不断变化的预测结果，但却无法获取先前程序与追踪记录，因而无从判断一个高分条目实际上执行了哪些操作。

sents.en: The ledger-only arm is therefore exposed to uncertain historical scores without a way to check the underlying work, which helps explain its weaker result.
sents.zh: 因此，仅依赖账本的分支在缺乏验证底层工作成果的方式下，面临着不确定历史得分的风险，这也有助于解释其结果为何较弱。

sents.en: B3 and B4 can inspect that work through their history tools.
sents.zh: B3 和 B4 可以通过它们的历史记录工具来检查这些工作成果。

paragraphs.en: B3 trails B1 through much of the search and gains most in its final thirty iterations. Before two late improvements, the mutator queries prior programs, lineage, scores, and thinking traces. It then builds a counterfactual simulator for questions about alternate fee schemes and lookup cubes for card-scheme and ACI questions, testing both before acceptance. B1 also attempts substantial late changes, including a case bank for difficult questions; the distinction in these traces is that B3 consults the population’s history before deciding where to work, not that B1 is incapable of complex edits.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个搜索过程中，B3 一直紧随 B1 之后，并在最后三十次迭代中获益最多。 在两次晚期的改进之前，变异器会查询先前程序、谱系、得分和思维轨迹。 随后，它会为关于替代费用方案的问题构建一个反事实模拟器，并为卡片方案和 ACI 问题构建查找立方体，并在接受前对两者进行测试。 B1 也尝试了多项重大的晚期改动，包括为难题建立一个案例库；这些轨迹的区别在于，B3 在决定何处着手之前会参考种群的记录，而不是说 B1 无法进行复杂的编辑。

paragraphs.en: B4 reaches B1’s final score by roughly iteration 40 40 and improves further. Around iteration 36 36 , it queries earlier high-scoring programs and suggested questions, then builds and checks a vectorized aggregation engine for group-by questions. The checks expose an unsupported array/object parameter type, which the mutator works around before the edit is kept. Around iteration 84 84 , it adds a computation mode for ACI-selection questions and checks it against known cases. These episodes show the full arm using its history tools while carrying out substantial, verified edits.
paragraphs.zh: B4 大约在迭代 40 时达到 B1 的最终得分，并进一步得到提升。 在大约迭代 36 时，它会查询早期高分程序和推荐的问题，然后构建并检查一个用于“按组计算”问题的向量化聚合引擎。 这些检查暴露出一个不受支持的数组/对象参数类型，突变器在保留编辑前对此进行了处理。 在大约迭代 84 时，它为 ACI 选择问题添加了一种计算模式，并拿它与已知案例进行对比验证。 这些过程展示了完整的手臂在实施实质性且经过验证的编辑时，如何运用其历史工具。

paragraphs.en: A second B4 run uses the same configuration and model as the flagship but scores 248 / 300 248/300 on train and 114 / 150 114/150 on test, rather than 286 / 300 286/300 and 137 / 150 137/150 . It ends near B3’s primary 242 / 300 242/300 and 119 / 150 119/150 result despite having both history-access mechanisms available. The two B4 runs have similar Bash-call volume per iteration ( 32.3 32.3 versus 33.7 33.7 ), but allocate those calls differently. In the flagship, 2092 2092 of 3229 3229 Bash calls invoke evo.py and 974 974 invoke evo_sweep.py , about 95 % 95\% combined. In the second run, 1671 1671 of 3367 3367 invoke evo.py and 127 127 invoke evo_sweep.py , about 53 % 53\% combined. The remaining calls, many of which inspect the edited blueprint directly, are far more common in the second run (about 47 % 47\% versus 5 % 5\% ). The tool-use pattern and outcome vary together in these two runs; tool use was observed rather than assigned as another ablation treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 第二次 B4 运行使用了与旗舰版本相同的配置和模型，但在训练集上的得分为 248 / 300 248/300，测试集上的得分为 114 / 150 114/150，而非 286 / 300 286/300 和 137 / 150 137/150。 尽管同时具备两种历史访问机制，其最终结果仍接近 B3 的主要结果 242 / 300 242/300 和 119 / 150 119/150。 两次 B4 运行每次迭代的 Bash 调用量相似（32.3 32.3 对比 33.7 33.7），但这些调用的分配方式不同。 在旗舰版本中，3229 次 Bash 调用中有 2092 次调用了 evo.py，974 次调用了 evo_sweep.py，合计约占 95 % 95\%。 在第二次运行中，3367 次调用中有 1671 次调用了 evo.py，127 次调用了 evo_sweep.py，合计约占 53 % 53\%。 其余的调用（其中许多是直接检查编辑后的蓝图）在第二次运行中更为常见（约 47 % 47\% 对比 5 % 5\%）。 在这两次运行中，工具使用模式与结果同步变化；工具的使用是实际观察到的，而非作为另一种消融实验处理被指定。

paragraphs.en: We test whether the true question-similarity graph improves DABStep target selection and expansion. The full semantic configuration (C3) scores well above the uniform and shuffled controls in these runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试了真实的相似性问题图是否提升了 DABStep 的目标选择和扩展效果。 在这些运行中，完整的语义配置（C3）的得分明显高于均匀控制和打乱控制。

sents.en: We test whether the true question-similarity graph improves DABStep target selection and expansion.
sents.zh: 我们测试了真实的相似性问题图是否提升了 DABStep 的目标选择和扩展效果。

sents.en: The full semantic configuration (C3) scores well above the uniform and shuffled controls in these runs.
sents.zh: 在这些运行中，完整的语义配置（C3）的得分明显高于均匀控制和打乱控制。

paragraphs.en: All three arms use DABStep’s 300-question training pool and keep the mutator, history-access interface, parent policy, first-evaluation gate, regression-sample size, expansion-question count, scout count, and acceleration budget fixed. The evolution graph remains enabled in every arm. The arms differ in how they select a target and expand evaluation to previously untested questions, as described below.
paragraphs.zh: 所有三个分支都使用 DABStep 的 300 题训练池，并保持突变器、历史访问接口、父策略、首次评估门限、回归样本大小、扩展问题数量、侦察数量以及加速预算固定不变。 演化图在所有分支中均保持启用状态。 这些分支在如何选择目标以及如何将评估扩展到此前未测试过的问题上有所不同，具体如下文所述。

sents.en: All three arms use DABStep’s 300-question training pool and keep the mutator, history-access interface, parent policy, first-evaluation gate, regression-sample size, expansion-question count, scout count, and acceleration budget fixed.
sents.zh: 所有三个分支都使用 DABStep 的 300 题训练池，并保持突变器、历史访问接口、父策略、首次评估门限、回归样本大小、扩展问题数量、侦察数量以及加速预算固定不变。

sents.en: The evolution graph remains enabled in every arm.
sents.zh: 演化图在所有分支中均保持启用状态。

sents.en: The arms differ in how they select a target and expand evaluation to previously untested questions, as described below.
sents.zh: 这些分支在如何选择目标以及如何将评估扩展到此前未测试过的问题上有所不同，具体如下文所述。

paragraphs.en: C1 ( uniform matched control ) samples the target uniformly from the same unsolved candidate set, keeps the regression step identical, and evaluates the same number of random previously untested questions, including the same scout count; persistent solved-state, donor registry, and target-attempt counts are retained. C2 ( shuffled similarity graph ) runs C3’s identical information-gain formula, but reads the similarity term off a symmetric index permutation of the real matrix rather than the real values — same value distribution, wrong question pairing, isolating whether the specific semantic geometry matters rather than merely having some structured (non-uniform) sampling bias. C3 ( full semantic manifold ) selects the target by information gain over questions the parent has not solved, runs the usual regression sample from the parent’s cumulative solved set, and expands the search to semantically similar previously untested questions; archive-wide solvers may be retrieved as donors. All three arms share the same regression-risk sampler: whatever target a given arm’s rule selects, that target’s most at-risk previously-solved questions are drawn from the true, unpermuted similarity graph. Only target selection and untested-question expansion differ across arms.
paragraphs.zh: C1（均匀匹配控制）从相同的未解决候选集中均匀采样目标，保持回归步骤完全一致，并评估相同数量的随机未测试问题，包括相同的侦察问题数量；同时保留持续存在的已解决状态、捐赠者注册表和目标尝试次数。 C2（打乱相似性图）运行与C3完全相同的信息增益公式，但将相似性项从真实矩阵的对称索引排列中读取，而非直接读取真实值——值分布相同，但问题配对错误，从而隔离出特定的语义几何结构是否重要，而不仅仅是存在某种结构化（非均匀）的采样偏差。 C3（完整语义流形）通过评估父智能体尚未解决的问题的信息增益来选择目标，从父智能体的累计已解决集中运行常规的回归采样，并将搜索范围扩展到语义相似的未测试问题；整个档案库中的求解器均可被检索作为捐赠者。 所有三个分支共享相同的回归风险采样器：无论某个分支的规则选择了哪个目标，都会从真实且未经排列的相似性图中抽取该目标风险最高的已解决问题。 各分支之间仅目标选择和未测试问题的扩展部分存在差异。

sents.en: C1 ( uniform matched control ) samples the target uniformly from the same unsolved candidate set, keeps the regression step identical, and evaluates the same number of random previously untested questions, including the same scout count; persistent solved-state, donor registry, and target-attempt counts are retained.
sents.zh: C1（均匀匹配控制）从相同的未解决候选集中均匀采样目标，保持回归步骤完全一致，并评估相同数量的随机未测试问题，包括相同的侦察问题数量；同时保留持续存在的已解决状态、捐赠者注册表和目标尝试次数。

sents.en: C2 ( shuffled similarity graph ) runs C3’s identical information-gain formula, but reads the similarity term off a symmetric index permutation of the real matrix rather than the real values — same value distribution, wrong question pairing, isolating whether the specific semantic geometry matters rather than merely having some structured (non-uniform) sampling bias.
sents.zh: C2（打乱相似性图）运行与C3完全相同的信息增益公式，但将相似性项从真实矩阵的对称索引排列中读取，而非直接读取真实值——值分布相同，但问题配对错误，从而隔离出特定的语义几何结构是否重要，而不仅仅是存在某种结构化（非均匀）的采样偏差。

sents.en: C3 ( full semantic manifold ) selects the target by information gain over questions the parent has not solved, runs the usual regression sample from the parent’s cumulative solved set, and expands the search to semantically similar previously untested questions; archive-wide solvers may be retrieved as donors.
sents.zh: C3（完整语义流形）通过评估父智能体尚未解决的问题的信息增益来选择目标，从父智能体的累计已解决集中运行常规的回归采样，并将搜索范围扩展到语义相似的未测试问题；整个档案库中的求解器均可被检索作为捐赠者。

sents.en: All three arms share the same regression-risk sampler: whatever target a given arm’s rule selects, that target’s most at-risk previously-solved questions are drawn from the true, unpermuted similarity graph.
sents.zh: 所有三个分支共享相同的回归风险采样器：无论某个分支的规则选择了哪个目标，都会从真实且未经排列的相似性图中抽取该目标风险最高的已解决问题。

sents.en: Only target selection and untested-question expansion differ across arms.
sents.zh: 各分支之间仅目标选择和未测试问题的扩展部分存在差异。

paragraphs.en: C3’s champion is the flagship run already reported in Table 1 ; we report a fresh full-pool re-evaluation of that same champion here, rather than the in-run bookkeeping trajectory used elsewhere, to match C1/C2’s methodology exactly.
paragraphs.zh: C3 的冠军是表 1 中已报告的旗舰运行；此处我们报告对该冠军的全新全池重新评估，而非在其他地方使用的运行内记录轨迹，以便与 C1/C2 的方法论完全一致。

paragraphs.en: One 100-iteration Sonnet-5 trial per fresh arm (C1, C2); C3 and A1 reuse the flagship and seed champions already reported elsewhere, each freshly re-evaluated against the same full pools as C1/C2.
paragraphs.zh: 每个新分支（C1、C2）进行 100 次迭代的 Sonnet-5 试验；C3 和 A1 则复用已在别处报告的旗舰模型和种子冠军模型，并分别针对与 C1/C2 相同的完整池重新进行评估。

paragraphs.en: C3 reaches 286 / 300 286/300 on train and 137 / 150 137/150 on test, well above C1 ( 95 / 300 95/300 , 42 / 150 42/150 ) and C2 ( 113 / 300 113/300 , 51 / 150 51/150 ). C1 scores below the seed ( 101 / 300 101/300 , 47 / 150 47/150 ), while C2 is only slightly above it. A repeat held-out evaluation of C2’s champion scored 49 / 150 49/150 rather than 51 / 150 51/150 , underscoring the small size of that margin.

sents.en: C1 scores below the seed ( 101 / 300 101/300 , 47 / 150 47/150 ), while C2 is only slightly above it.
A repeat held-out evaluation of C2’s champion scored 49 / 150 49/150 rather than 51 / 150 51/150 , underscoring the small size of that margin.
sents.zh: 对C2冠军模型进行重复的预留集评估时，其得分为49 / 150 49/150，而非51 / 150 51/150，这凸显了该差距其实非常小。

paragraphs.en: The per-question comparison in Table 14 shows both more gains and fewer regressions for C3: it gains 189 189 questions and regresses 4 4 , versus 29 29 gained/ 35 35 regressed for C1 and 28 28 gained/ 16 16 regressed for C2. Most gains in every arm transfer beyond its directly targeted questions (C3: 143 / 189 143/189 ; C1: 25 / 29 25/29 ; C2: 22 / 28 22/28 ). All arms use the true graph for regression-risk sampling, so aligning target selection and expansion with that graph may help protect previously solved neighbors. These runs evaluate those two semantic operations together; they do not separate their contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 表14中每道题的比较显示，C3的增益更多且退步更少：它获得了189道题，仅退步4道；而C1获得了29道题，退步35道；C2获得了28道题，退步16道。 每个分支的大部分增益都超越了其直接针对的题目（C3：143/189；C1：25/29；C2：22/28）。 所有分支在回归风险采样时都使用真实图，因此将目标选择和扩展与该图对齐，可能有助于保护之前已解决的相邻节点。 这些运行同时评估了这两种语义操作，并未区分它们各自的贡献。

paragraphs.en: CoCoEvolve uses Cortex Code as its mutator, alongside a reflector and proposer. The mutator edits the candidate in its workspace. The reflector chooses keep , new , or none from the approach ledger; new invokes the proposer to name a strategy. The excerpts below show the instructions relevant to these roles.
paragraphs.zh: CoCoEvolve 使用 Cortex Code 作为其变异器，并配合一个反射器和提议器。 变异器在其工作空间中编辑候选方案。 反射器从方法记录簿中选择“保留”、“新建”或“无”；“新建”会调用提议器来命名一种策略。 下面的摘录展示了与这些角色相关的说明。

sents.en: CoCoEvolve uses Cortex Code as its mutator, alongside a reflector and proposer.
sents.zh: CoCoEvolve 使用 Cortex Code 作为其变异器，并配合一个反射器和提议器。

sents.en: The mutator edits the candidate in its workspace.
sents.zh: 变异器在其工作空间中编辑候选方案。

sents.en: The reflector chooses keep , new , or none from the approach ledger; new invokes the proposer to name a strategy.
sents.zh: 反射器从方法记录簿中选择“保留”、“新建”或“无”；“新建”会调用提议器来命名一种策略。

sents.en: The excerpts below show the instructions relevant to these roles.
sents.zh: 下面的摘录展示了与这些角色相关的说明。

paragraphs.en: The math, ADRS, and Signal Processing mutators share the same generic interface: an injected ledger, on-demand evo.py history queries, and a task workspace for editing and execution. DABStep replaces the generic system message with a Cortex-agent builder prompt that adds warehouse tools. The data engineering prompt defines the scaffolding of the context-curation pipeline that CoCoEvolve improves.
paragraphs.zh: 数学、ADRS 和信号处理突变器共享相同的通用接口：一个注入的账本、按需的 evo.py 历史查询，以及用于编辑和执行的任务工作区。 DABStep 将通用系统消息替换为 Cortex-agent 构建提示，从而增加了仓库工具。 数据工程提示定义了上下文整理流程的结构，而 CoCoEvolve 则对此进行了改进。

sents.en: The math, ADRS, and Signal Processing mutators share the same generic interface: an injected ledger, on-demand evo.py history queries, and a task workspace for editing and execution.
sents.zh: 数学、ADRS 和信号处理突变器共享相同的通用接口：一个注入的账本、按需的 evo.py 历史查询，以及用于编辑和执行的任务工作区。

sents.en: DABStep replaces the generic system message with a Cortex-agent builder prompt that adds warehouse tools.
sents.zh: DABStep 将通用系统消息替换为 Cortex-agent 构建提示，从而增加了仓库工具。

paragraphs.en: DABStep optimization uses the InfoGain branch of Algorithm 1 over a 300-question training pool, with a disjoint held-out test split reported in Table 1 . The run behind Table 15 uses a 100-iteration budget, one island, population 40, cascade threshold [ 0.005 ] [0.005] , a task workspace, evo.py lineage tools, and the warehouse overlay of Appendix C.2 . The seed p 0 p_{0} is a Cortex Agent blueprint with instructions, payment_analytics text-to-SQL, docs_search , and a single-transaction fee_calculator . The mutator may rewrite the instructions, tool schemas, stored procedures, and dynamic tables. GEPA receives the same specification but optimizes only its instruction text. A post-hoc full-pool evaluation of its champion scores 142 / 300 142/300 on train and 59 / 150 59/150 on test (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: DABStep 优化在包含 300 道题的训练池中使用了算法 1 的 InfoGain 分支，其互斥的预留测试集划分结果见表 1。 表 15 背后的运行配置使用了 100 次迭代的预算、一个岛、40 个个体、级联阈值 [0.005] [0.005]、一个任务工作区、evo.py 谱系工具以及附录 C.2 中的仓库覆盖层。 种子 p₀（p_{0}）是一个 Cortex Agent 蓝图，包含指令、payment_analytics 文本转 SQL、docs_search 以及一个单交易 fee_calculator。 变异器可能重写指令、工具模式、存储过程和动态表。 GEPA 接收相同的规格，但仅优化其指令文本。 对其冠军模型的全池事后评估显示，训练集得分为 142/300，测试集得分为 59/150（见表 1）。

paragraphs.en: Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) receives the same seed and 100-iteration budget through a faithful port of the Terminal-Bench-2 loop. The proposer prompt contains only a file pointer and receives no curated history or pre-injected per-question signal, matching the original design. We make two changes to the port. Cortex replaces the Anthropic API as the proposer backend, and the pooled-parallel DABStep evaluator replaces Harbor sandboxes. Each child is a Cortex Agent JSON specification scored on all 300 training questions.
paragraphs.zh: Meta-Harness（Lee 等人，2026）通过忠实移植 Terminal-Bench-2 循环，接收相同的种子和 100 次迭代的预算。 提议者提示仅包含一个文件指针，未接收任何经过筛选的历史记录或每道题预先注入的信号，这与原始设计一致。 我们对这个移植版本进行了两项修改。 Cortex 取代了 Anthropic API 作为提议者后端，而池化并行 DABStep 评估器则取代了 Harbor 沙箱。 每个子智能体都是一个 Cortex Agent JSON 规范，该规范在所有 300 道训练问题上进行了评分。

sents.zh: Meta-Harness（Lee 等人，2026）通过忠实移植 Terminal-Bench-2 循环，接收相同的种子和 100 次迭代的预算。

paragraphs.en: The main-paper Meta-Harness row uses the self-test variant. Its proposer receives test_draft , test_agent , and check_deploy , which provide the same self-validation surface as CoCoEvolve’s A3 arm (Appendix D.2 ). A held-out re-evaluation of the champion produces 80.0 % 80.0\% easy accuracy ( 20 / 25 20/25 ), 78.4 % 78.4\% hard accuracy ( 98 / 125 98/125 ), and 78.7 % 78.7\% total accuracy ( 118 / 150 118/150 ), with no evaluator errors. These are the values in Table 1 . Figure 3 plots best-so-far train accuracy against iteration for all three methods.
paragraphs.zh: 主论文中的 Meta-Harness 行使用了自测试变体。 其提出者接收 test_draft、test_agent 和 check_deploy，这些提供了与 CoCoEvolve 的 A3 分支（附录 D.2）相同的自我验证表面。 对冠军模型进行预留的重评估得出：简单任务准确率为 80.0%（20/25），困难任务准确率为 78.4%（98/125），总准确率为 78.7%（118/150），且没有评估器错误。 这些值即为表 1 中的数值。 图 3 绘制了三种方法中迄今最佳训练准确率随迭代次数的变化。

paragraphs.en: Stock Cortex Agent removes the Cortex Agent product entirely. A single Cortex Code CLI call using claude-sonnet-5 answers each question in a fresh session without memory or an evolutionary loop. The model receives the DABStep documentation and read-only SQL access to the live tables. It does not receive a semantic view, text-to-SQL tool, fee-calculation procedure, or the seed’s domain-specific instructions. Together, these two rows bound performance without search: the first retains the seed specification, while the second retains only a general-purpose coding agent with raw data access.
paragraphs.zh: Stock Cortex Agent 完全移除了 Cortex Agent 产品。 使用 claude-sonnet-5 的单个 Cortex Code CLI 调用会在每次新的会话中回答每个问题，且没有记忆或进化循环。 该模型会收到 DABStep 文档以及对实时表格的只读 SQL 访问权限。 它不会收到语义视图、文本转 SQL 工具、费用计算流程或种子程序的领域特定指令。 这两行共同界定了无需搜索的性能边界：第一行保留了种子规范，而第二行仅保留了一个具有原始数据访问权限的通用编码智能体。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows Meta-Harness’s self-test variant landing its one real gain at iteration 53 53 and then failing to improve for the remaining 47 47 iterations despite holding the same test_draft / test_agent / check_deploy self-validation surface throughout. We inspected the archived per-iteration tool-call transcripts to understand the stall. They show two recurring problems: repeated searches for nonexistent question tables and semantic-view edits that pass the preliminary check but fail at deployment. These traces explain failures in this run; they do not establish that either problem would persist under every use of the self-test tools.
paragraphs.zh: 图3显示，Meta-Harness的自测试变体在第53次迭代时实现了唯一一次真正的改进，但此后尽管在整个过程中始终保持相同的test_draft / test_agent / check_deploy自我验证表面，却未能在这剩余的47次迭代中取得进一步改进。 为了理解这一停滞现象，我们检查了存档的每次迭代对应的工具调用记录。 这些记录显示了两个反复出现的问题：重复搜索不存在的问题表，以及语义视图编辑通过了初步检查却在部署时失败的情况。 这些追踪信息解释了本次运行中的失败原因，但并未证明这两个问题在每次使用自测试工具时都会持续存在。

paragraphs.en: The recurring failure is different. On each occurrence, the proposer spends nine calls looking for DABSTEP_QUESTIONS , DABSTEP_EVAL_QUESTIONS , and DABSTEP_EVAL . These tables do not exist because the question and answer bank is stored only in frontier_val.json and evolution_summary.jsonl . The prompt tells the proposer to read these files for per-question pass rates, but it never states that they are the only source of question-level information.
paragraphs.zh: 这种重复出现的故障有所不同。 每次发生时，提议者都会花费九次调用来查找 DABSTEP_QUESTIONS、DABSTEP_EVAL_QUESTIONS 和 DABSTEP_EVAL。 这些表并不存在，因为问题和答案库仅存储在 frontier_val.json 和 evolution_summary.jsonl 中。 提示要求提议者读取这些文件以获取每个问题的通过率，但从未说明这些文件是问题层面信息的唯一来源。

paragraphs.en: At iteration 61 61 , the proposer edits both representations with ad hoc Python string operations. It inserts a relationship into the outer clause and separately patches the JSON table list instead of generating both from one source of truth. The two representations can therefore drift apart. In this case, a table appears in tables() but not in the JSON.
