paragraphs.en: The resulting text is syntactically well formed, so check_deploy cannot reject it in advance. That tool checks whether the DDL compiles but does not perform a data-flow check ( mh_tools.py ). It can catch syntax failures, as it did for an unescaped quote in an earlier iteration, but it cannot validate cross-references between the two representations. Only the live Snowflake compiler exposes that error, and it returns only a line and position rather than a diff.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的文本在语法上是正确的，因此 check_deploy 无法提前拒绝它。 该工具会检查 DDL 是否能成功编译，但不会执行数据流检查（mh_tools.py）。 它可以检测出语法错误，就像在之前的迭代中检测到未转义的引号那样，但它无法验证两种表示形式之间的交叉引用。 只有实时的 Snowflake 编译器会暴露该错误，并且它只会返回行号和位置，而不是差异对比。

paragraphs.en: The observed failures point to distinct remedies. A prompt that identifies where question-level data lives and carries learned dead ends forward could reduce repeated fruitless queries. Structural validation of the semantic view’s two representations could catch the DDL mismatch before deployment. In this run, self-test access alone did not supply either safeguard.
paragraphs.zh: 观察到的故障表明需要不同的解决方案。 一个能够识别问题层级数据位置并传递已学习到的死胡同信息的提示，或许可以减少重复的无效查询。 对语义视图两种表示的结构验证，可以在部署前发现 DDL 不匹配问题。 在这次运行中，仅靠自我测试访问并未提供这两种保障中的任何一种。

paragraphs.en: DABStep’s artifact is a Cortex Agent spec ( Snowflake Inc., 2026a ) . The champion reached an in-run train estimate of 293 / 300 293/300 ( combined_score 0.977 0.977 ). A fresh full-pool re-evaluation of the same artifact scored 286 / 300 286/300 , as reported in Table 13 . While the mutator discovered a suite of optimizations across the specification (including refined verified queries, precise orchestration instructions for disambiguation, and injected domain context), we highlight the architectural shift we believe contributed most to its performance: demoting the text-to-SQL surface in favor of a deterministic compute kernel. By routing fee, ranking, and glossary questions around the LLM entirely, it avoids freehand SQL errors. The champion agent achieved this by rewriting the custom tool from a 5KB SQL procedure to a 53KB Python engine with 14 modes, backed by NumPy, SciPy, and NetworkX. The agent can therefore answer complex questions with a single tool call instead of summing many single-row fees in context, directly addressing the failure mode discussed in Section 3 .
paragraphs.zh: DABStep 的产物是一个 Cortex Agent 规范（Snowflake Inc., 2026a）。 冠军智能体在运行中的训练评估得分达到 293/300（combined_score 为 0.977）。 对同一产物的全新完整池重评估得分为 286/300，如表 13 所示。 尽管变异器在该规范中发现了一系列优化方案（包括经过优化的验证查询、用于消除歧义的精确编排指令以及注入的领域上下文），但我们重点强调我们认为对其性能贡献最大的架构转变：降低文本转 SQL 接口的作用，转而采用确定性计算内核。 通过将费用、排名和术语表相关的问题完全绕过 LLM，该智能体避免了自由发挥的 SQL 错误。 冠军智能体通过将一个自定义工具从 5KB 的 SQL 过程重写成包含 14 种模式的 53KB Python 引擎（由 NumPy、SciPy 和 NetworkX 提供支持）实现了这一点。 因此，该智能体可以通过单次工具调用回答复杂问题，而无需在上下文中累加多个单行费用，从而直接解决了第 3 节中讨论的故障模式。

paragraphs.en: Vectorized tensor contraction. The initial tool used SQL to evaluate 9-field conditional fee rules. The champion replaces this with a sparse boolean tensor contraction in Python. It precomputes a boolean “allowed” matrix for each field where wildcards become an all-True row, combines them via bitwise & , and computes the final fees using sparse matrix-vector products ( scipy.sparse.csr_matrix ).
paragraphs.zh: 向量化张量收缩。 最初使用的工具通过 SQL 来评估 9 字段的条件费用规则。 冠军方案用 Python 中的稀疏布尔张量收缩取代了这种方法。 该方案会预先计算每个字段的布尔“允许”矩阵，其中通配符会变成全为真的行，然后通过按位与操作将它们组合起来，并利用稀疏矩阵-向量乘积（scipy.sparse.csr_matrix）计算最终费用。

sents.zh: 向量化张量收缩。

paragraphs.en: Semantic bug fixes. The mutator fixed two silent bugs in the human-authored seed. First, it corrected a whitespace bug in a string label ( ’> 5’ to ’>5’ ) that had silently disabled 92 fee rules for 6 merchants. Second, it redefined “intracountry” transactions from IP_COUNTRY = ISSUING_COUNTRY to ISSUING_COUNTRY = ACQUIRER_COUNTRY , a definitional shift that alters the evaluation of 70% of the 138,236 rows in the dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 语义错误修复。 该变异器修复了人类编写的种子数据中的两个静默错误。 首先，它修正了一个字符串标签中的空白符错误（从 ’> 5’ 改为 ’>5’），该错误曾静默地禁用了对 6 家商户的 92 条费用规则。 其次，它将“国内”交易的定义从 IP_COUNTRY = ISSUING_COUNTRY 重新定义为 ISSUING_COUNTRY = ACQUIRER_COUNTRY，这一定义变更改变了数据集中 138,236 行数据中 70% 行的评估结果。

sents.zh: 语义错误修复。

sents.zh: 该变异器修复了人类编写的种子数据中的两个静默错误。

sents.en: Second, it redefined “intracountry” transactions from IP_COUNTRY = ISSUING_COUNTRY to ISSUING_COUNTRY = ACQUIRER_COUNTRY , a definitional shift that alters the evaluation of 70% of the 138,236 rows in the dataset.
sents.zh: 其次，它将“国内”交易的定义从 IP_COUNTRY = ISSUING_COUNTRY 重新定义为 ISSUING_COUNTRY = ACQUIRER_COUNTRY，这一定义变更改变了数据集中 138,236 行数据中 70% 行的评估结果。

paragraphs.en: Emergent domain semantics. The agent discovered through trial and error that fees stack . Its code comments explicitly warn its future self: “because fees STACK… Do NOT take the MAX of a single matching rule… that produces a different (and wrong) ranking.”
paragraphs.zh: 涌现的领域语义。 该智能体通过反复尝试发现，费用会叠加。 其代码注释明确提醒未来的自己：“因为费用会叠加……绝不要取单个匹配规则的最大值……这会产生不同的（且错误的）排名。”

paragraphs.en: Graph-based join resolution. Rather than letting the orchestrator guess join keys for text-to-SQL, the tool hardcodes the schema’s foreign-key graph and uses networkx.shortest_path to emit deterministic JOIN ... ON fragments, returning an explicit refusal if no path exists.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图的连接解析。 该工具不会让协调器猜测文本到 SQL 的连接键，而是将模式的外键图硬编码，并使用 networkx.shortest_path 来生成确定性的 JOIN ... ON 片段，如果不存在路径，则返回明确的拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Regex over semantic search. For exact-definition questions, the agent deliberately replaces vector search with a regex and difflib parser over the documentation, reasoning that embeddings might return a topically-related chunk that omits the exact definition.

paragraphs.en: Beyond the champion tool shown above, other evolutionary lineages explored alternative structural solutions. The most notable alternatives materialized dynamic tables to pre-compute frequently-joined columns and eliminate flaky on-the-fly joins and produced detailed sets of verified queries encoding domain-specific reasoning paths. While these alternative approaches were interesting, they ultimately lost to the champion’s centralized Python compute kernel. Across all lineages, the agent also continually refined its orchestration guidelines, encoding lessons from observed failures into tight situational guardrails.
paragraphs.zh: 除了上面展示的冠军工具之外，其他演化分支还探索了替代性的结构解决方案。 最引人注目的替代方案是动态表格，用于预计算频繁关联的列，从而消除不稳定的实时关联操作，并生成包含领域特定推理路径的详细验证查询集。 尽管这些替代方法颇具新意，但最终仍不敌冠军工具所采用的集中式 Python 计算内核。 在所有演化分支中，智能体还持续优化其协调指南，将观察到的失败经验转化为严格的场景约束规则。

paragraphs.en: The seed provides all six candidate sets but only one of the twelve interference rules. Every method receives the same 50 labeled strings and 50 mutation iterations. There is no held-out partition: train and test are the same fixed set, because the measured quantity is exact reconstruction of the latent rule system rather than distributional generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 种子提供了全部六个候选集，但只提供了十二条干扰规则中的其中一条。 每种方法都接收到相同的 50 个带标签的字符串和 50 次突变迭代。 没有预留的数据划分：训练集和测试集是同一个固定集合，因为所测量的量是对潜在规则系统的精确重建，而非分布上的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator returns only the final count, not which positions were invalidated. In the example above, if both triggers fire, omitting either edge into P 1 P_{1} need not change that row’s label. A trigger can likewise be masked when its target was already rejected by the candidate-set check or an earlier rule. Consequently, many structurally different rule tables agree on most of the 50 examples. This property makes the diagnostic useful: a locally successful patch can raise accuracy without identifying the rule responsible for the improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器仅返回最终计数，而不说明哪些位置被判定无效。 在上面的例子中，如果两个触发器都被激活，省略指向 P 1 P_{1} 的任意一条边，都不必改变该行标签。 同样地，当某个触发器的目标已通过候选集检查或更早的规则被拒绝时，该触发器也可以被屏蔽。 因此，许多结构不同的规则表在大多数 50 个例子上的结果是一致的。 这一特性使得诊断方法具有实用价值：一个局部成功的补丁可能提升准确率，却无法确定是哪条规则导致了这种改进。

paragraphs.en: CoCoEvolve reaches 50 / 50 50/50 after six mutations by contrasting multiple failures and compiling all twelve recovered rules into deterministic SQL. OpenEvolve ends at 27 / 50 27/50 with unresolved contradictions in its own worked examples. AdaEvolve reaches 45 / 50 45/50 at iteration 34 and then plateaus: only two of its twelve learned trigger rows have the correct target pair, five reuse the same [P3,P5] shortcut, and none can invalidate P 1 P_{1} . The gap is therefore structural rather than evaluation noise: the baselines fit surrogate rules that score well on the fixed set, whereas CoCoEvolve recovers the latent rule system.
paragraphs.zh: CoCoEvolve 经过六次变异后，通过对比多次失败并将所有十二条恢复的规则整合为确定性 SQL，达到了 50 / 50 50/50。 OpenEvolve 最终停留在 27 / 50 27/50，其自身的工作示例中存在未解决的矛盾。 AdaEvolve 在第 34 次迭代时达到 45 / 50 45/50，随后进入平台期：其十二条学习到的触发行中仅有两条具有正确的目标对，五条重复使用了相同的 [P3,P5] 捷径，且没有一条能够使 P 1 P_{1} 失效。 因此，这一差距是结构性的，而非评估噪声所致：基线模型拟合了能在固定数据集上获得高分的代理规则，而 CoCoEvolve 则恢复了潜在的规则系统。

paragraphs.en: Each candidate is an executable Snowflake SQL expression that forms the body of a scalar AI function. The seed for every task contains one AI_COMPLETE call, a task instruction, a row-dependent user message, and a structured-output schema. Evolution may rewrite the instruction and schema descriptions, introduce CTEs or deterministic SQL post-processing, and compose multiple model calls, but it must preserve the function signature, output field and type, and final accessor. Thus the search space includes both prompt optimization and pipeline optimization while every candidate remains directly executable by the target query engine. The seed is deliberately minimal: for example, the go_emotions seed asks for every emotion that “clearly applies,” and the multilexnorm seed gives only four normalization examples.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选方案都是一个可执行的 Snowflake SQL 表达式，构成标量 AI 函数的主体。 每个任务的种子都包含一个 AI_COMPLETE 调用、一条任务指令、一条依赖行的用户消息以及一个结构化输出模式。 演化过程可以重写指令和模式的描述，引入 CTE 或确定性 SQL 后处理，并组合多个模型调用，但必须保留函数签名、输出字段和类型以及最终的访问器。 因此，搜索空间既包括提示优化，也包括流程优化，同时每个候选方案都能由目标查询引擎直接执行。 种子被刻意设计得极为精简：例如，go_emotions 种子要求列出所有“明显适用”的情感，而 multilexnorm 种子仅提供四个归一化示例。

paragraphs.en: The five live-data tasks use the following row-level objectives: go_emotions uses example-level multi-label F1; finqa and convfinqa use execution accuracy after canonicalizing the returned numeric answer; lex_glue uses exact match over thirteen Supreme Court issue areas; and multilexnorm uses exact string match, including case, punctuation, and spacing. The synthetic lockpicking_6 diagnostic uses exact match on the integer score. A malformed SQL body, invalid structured output, or warehouse execution failure receives score zero together with the compilation or execution diagnostic.
paragraphs.zh: 五个实时数据任务采用以下行级目标：go_emotions 使用示例级的多标签 F1；finqa 和 convfinqa 在对返回的数值答案进行规范化处理后使用执行准确率；lex_glue 在十三个最高法院议题领域上使用精确匹配；而 multilexnorm 则使用精确字符串匹配，包括大小写、标点和空格。 合成锁具破解_6 诊断任务对整数分数进行精确匹配。 如果 SQL 主体格式错误、结构化输出无效或仓库执行失败，将连同编译或执行诊断信息一起获得零分。

paragraphs.en: For each live-data task, the search pool is partitioned once with seed 42. Two thirds form a validation split used only for fitness and acceptance, while the remaining third supplies row contents and scorer feedback to the mutation agent. The disjoint test table is never exposed during evolution; after the 50-iteration run, the exported validation champion is re-executed on that test table to obtain Table 2 . This separation is important because the mutator can inspect concrete training failures. lockpicking_6 is intentionally different: all examples are visible and scored because its purpose is to test whether search can reconstruct a hidden rule system rather than generalize to an unseen natural-data split.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个实时数据任务，搜索池都会使用种子值 42 进行一次划分。 其中三分之二构成验证集，仅用于适应度评估和接受判断；而剩余的三分之一则为变异智能体提供行内容以及评分器反馈。 独立的测试表在整个演化过程中绝不会被访问；在 50 次迭代运行结束后，导出的验证冠军将被重新在该测试表上执行，以得到表 2。 这种分离至关重要，因为变异器可以检查具体的训练失败情况。lockpicking_6 的设计则刻意不同：其所有示例都是可见且可评分的，因为其目的是测试搜索能否重构一个隐藏的规则系统，而非对未见的自然数据划分进行泛化。

paragraphs.en: The AI-function runs instantiate the general loop in Appendix C.1 , the history interface in Appendix C.2 , and the ℓ p \ell^{p} roster in Appendix C.5 . Their task-specific specialization is a fresh-session curator–mutator split: the curator inspects the roster, ledger, and training-only failure history to select a parent, an optional merge partner, and up to ten representative rows; the mutator receives only that bounded packet and may verify its SQL on those rows up to three times. The subsequent full-validation evaluation is the sole admission gate. Runs use 50 mutation attempts, one island, population 40, archive capacity 20, and eight parallel workers; similarity-informed targeting is disabled because every child is evaluated on the complete validation split.

paragraphs.en: The evolved programs remain ordinary SQL bodies, but they are substantially more operational than their seeds. Across tasks, evolution turns a generic instruction into an explicit decision procedure: ordered rules for classification, reference and sign conventions for numerical reasoning, or token-preservation contracts for normalization. We give representative examples below, reproducing the two lockpicking champions in full and abridging the longer live-task programs. For the live tasks, the base boxes show the task-bearing seed instruction; we omit repeated label enumerations, the AI_COMPLETE wrapper, and the unchanged structured-output schema.
paragraphs.zh: 演化后的程序仍然是普通的 SQL 代码，但它们的运行能力比初始程序强得多。 在各种任务中，演化将通用指令转化为明确的决策流程：用于分类的有序规则、数值推理中的引用和符号约定，或用于归一化的标记保留协议。 我们在下文给出代表性示例，完整呈现两个锁具破解冠军程序，并对较长的实时任务程序进行删减。 对于实时任务，基础框展示了承载任务的初始指令；我们省略了重复的标签枚举、AI_COMPLETE 包装器以及未更改的结构化输出方案。

paragraphs.en: The seed’s instruction to include every plausible emotion caused systematic over-labeling. At iteration 7, the curator queried the seed’s full failure set, inspected representative rows, and then used question memory to contextualize partial scores. For “Happy Cake day!” the gold label was joy but the parent received 0.5 0.5 ; for “This is my favorite wild memory” it received 0.4 0.4 . These scores exposed a common mechanism: the parent was returning the correct emotion together with one or more unnecessary labels. The curator prescribed a conservative single-label default. The mutator’s first draft passed eight of ten selected rows; after adding rules for sarcastic positive language and social check-ins, the same live verifier reported ten of ten. The committed child increased the search objective from 0.0022 0.0022 to 0.1741 0.1741 in one iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 种子要求包含所有合理情绪，导致系统性地过度标注。 在第 7 次迭代中，策展人查询了种子的完整失败集，检查了代表性行，然后利用问题记忆为部分分数提供上下文。 对于“Happy Cake day!”，标准标签是“喜悦”，但父智能体得到了 0.5 0.5；对于“This is my favorite wild memory”，则得到了 0.4 0.4。 这些分数揭示了一个常见机制：父智能体在返回正确情绪的同时，也附加了一个或多个不必要的标签。 策展人规定采用保守的单标签默认设置。 变异器的初稿通过了十行选中行中的八行；在增加了对讽刺性积极语言和社交签到规则后，同一实时验证器报告了十行全通过。 已提交的子智能体在一次迭代中，将搜索目标从 0.0022 0.0022 提高到了 0.1741 0.1741。

paragraphs.en: The champion was discovered at iteration 47 and obtains the held-out score 0.444 0.444 reported in Table 2 . Although the artifact is prompt-heavy, its structure is algorithmic: ordered guards, explicit exceptions, a closed vocabulary, and a forced structured output replace the seed’s unconstrained semantic judgment.

paragraphs.en: The financial-QA seeds merely ask the model to work out a numeric answer. Their champions instead define an operational contract for reference resolution, formula selection, sign direction, units, and answer serialization. The finqa program distinguishes percent change, signed absolute change, relative increase, same-period differences, ratios, averages, CAGR, and yes/no questions. The conversational champion adds rules for resolving “that,” “the difference,” and “the last year,” and for reusing prior answers without silently substituting a nearby year.
paragraphs.zh: 金融问答种子任务仅要求模型计算出一个数值答案。 而它们的冠军任务则定义了一份操作合同，用于指导参考解析、公式选择、符号方向、单位和答案序列化。 finqa 程序能够区分百分比变化、带符号的绝对变化、相对增长、同期差异、比率、平均值、年复合增长率以及是/否问题。 对话冠军任务还增加了处理“that”“the difference”和“the last year”的规则，并规定如何复用先前答案，而不会悄无声息地替换为附近的年份。

paragraphs.en: These contracts address errors that are difficult to repair with isolated answer demonstrations: the same numbers can require a ratio, signed difference, or magnitude depending on a short phrase. The resulting held-out scores are 0.813 0.813 for finqa and 0.953 0.953 for convfinqa .
paragraphs.zh: 这些合同解决了那些仅通过孤立的回答演示难以修复的错误：相同的数字可能因一个简短短语的不同而需要比率、带符号的差值或绝对值。 由此得到的保留分数为 finqa 的 0.813 0.813 和 convfinqa 的 0.953 0.953。

paragraphs.en: Exact-match normalization is unusually sensitive to helpful but unauthorized rewrites. The evolved champion therefore begins with preservation rules, then applies a bounded lexicon of high-confidence transformations while preserving capitalization, spacing, punctuation, mentions, hashtags, URLs, proper nouns, and uncertain or non-English tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 完全匹配归一化对有益但未获授权的改写异常敏感。 因此，演化出的冠军智能体首先采用保留规则，然后在保持大写、空格、标点符号、提及、话题标签、URL、专有名词以及不确定或非英语词元的同时，应用一个受限的高置信度转换词汇表。

sents.zh: 完全匹配归一化对有益但未获授权的改写异常敏感。

paragraphs.en: The final program also records exceptions for contractions, elongated forms, and truncated -ing words. This “transform only when confident” policy is the opposite of the seed’s broad invitation to normalize and achieves 0.587 0.587 on the held-out set, a 7.7 7.7 pp gain over GEPA.
paragraphs.zh: 最终程序还记录了对缩合形式、拉长形式和截断的 -ing 词形式的例外情况。 这种“仅在自信时进行转换”的策略与种子模型广泛呼吁规范化的做法相反，在保留集上取得了 0.587 的成绩，比 GEPA 提升了 7.7 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The legal classifier evolves from a short glossary into a hierarchy of issue-area distinctions. Its champion begins with a priority scan for attorney-fee holdings, then separates the constitutional substance of a case from its procedural posture. For example, it distinguishes a speaker denied access to a government forum ( First Amendment ) from a captive listener resisting unwanted content ( Privacy ); federal-court jurisdiction over an agency order ( Judicial Power ) from the substantive scope of an agency’s economic authority ( Economic Activity ); and federal labor preemption ( Federalism ) from the underlying labor right ( Unions ). The complete prompt is long, but these repeated “default–exception–counterexample” clauses are precisely the structure that the archive accumulated from observed confusions. The champion scores 0.737 0.737 on held-out opinions.
paragraphs.zh: 法律分类器从一个简短的术语表逐步演变为一个按议题领域划分的层级体系。 其冠军模型首先优先扫描是否存在律师费用相关条款，然后将案件的宪法实质与其程序状态区分开来。 例如，它能将政府论坛中被拒绝准入的发言者（第一修正案）与抗拒不想要内容的被动听众（隐私权）区分开；将联邦法院对机构命令的管辖权（司法权力）与机构经济权限的实质范围（经济活动）区分开；以及将联邦劳动法的优先适用原则（联邦主义）与底层的劳动权利（工会）区分开。 完整的提示词虽然很长，但这些重复出现的“默认–例外–反例”条款正是档案从观察到的混淆情况中积累出的结构。 该冠军模型在预留判例上的得分为 0.737 0.737。

paragraphs.en: A primary output of an evolved pipeline is a knowledge graph (KG), produced before the downstream agent attempts solving a task. The KG is a context-grounded markdown briefing, KG.md , limited to 300 lines. Evolved KGs describe schemas, tables, columns, dbt models, outputs, and metrics. They also record joins, cardinalities, source() / ref() lineage, model dependencies, derivations, model grain, business rules, boundary behavior, null handling, fanout risks, validation checks, and task-specific pitfalls.
paragraphs.zh: 演化后流程的主要输出是一个知识图谱（KG），在下游智能体尝试解决任务之前生成。 KG 是一份基于上下文的 Markdown 简报文件 KG.md，行数限制为 300 行。 演化后的 KG 描述了模式、表、列、dbt 模型、输出和指标。 它们还记录了连接、基数、source() / ref() 血缘关系、模型依赖、派生、模型粒度、业务规则、边界行为、空值处理、扇出风险、验证检查以及任务特定的陷阱。

The authoring pipeline verifies physical table locations, column types, categorical values, null encodings, and row counts using SHOW , DESCRIBE , INFORMATION_SCHEMA , and sql_execute . This avoids relying on a potentially stale _sources.yml file.

paragraphs.en: The evolved artifact is the Python dictionary _PIPELINE_SPEC in initial_program.py . It jointly controls the KG authoring protocols, agent orchestration, and adherence test authoring protocol. Executing this specification produces the task-specific KG.md and test_kg.py supplied to the downstream coding agent. The mutator can improve this pipeline through the following three components.
paragraphs.zh: 演化后的产物是 initial_program.py 中的 Python 字典 _PIPELINE_SPEC。 它共同控制 KG 编写协议、智能体协调以及合规性测试编写协议。 执行此规范会生成任务特定的 KG.md 和 test_kg.py，并将其提供给下游编码智能体。 变异器可以通过以下三个组件来改进此流程。

sents.en: The evolved artifact is the Python dictionary _PIPELINE_SPEC in initial_program.py .
sents.zh: 演化后的产物是 initial_program.py 中的 Python 字典 _PIPELINE_SPEC。

sents.en: It jointly controls the KG authoring protocols, agent orchestration, and adherence test authoring protocol.
sents.zh: 它共同控制 KG 编写协议、智能体协调以及合规性测试编写协议。

sents.en: Executing this specification produces the task-specific KG.md and test_kg.py supplied to the downstream coding agent.
sents.zh: 执行此规范会生成任务特定的 KG.md 和 test_kg.py，并将其提供给下游编码智能体。

sents.en: The mutator can improve this pipeline through the following three components.
sents.zh: 变异器可以通过以下三个组件来改进此流程。

paragraphs.en: KG authoring protocols. The skills{} catalog describes reusable procedures for constructing different parts of the KG, including its usage guide, metrics and business rules, and warehouse and model structure. Catalog entries contain metadata rather than complete skill bodies. During execution, assigned agents expand them into runtime_skills/<name>.md . These skills guide KG production and may be shared among agents in the authoring pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: KG 编写协议。 skills{} 目录描述了构建 KG 不同部分的可重用流程，包括其使用指南、指标与业务规则，以及仓库和模型结构。 目录条目包含元数据，而非完整的技能内容。 在执行过程中，指定的智能体会将其扩展为 runtime_skills/<name>.md。 这些技能指导 KG 的生成，并可在编写流程中的不同智能体之间共享。

sents.en: KG authoring protocols.
sents.zh: KG 编写协议。

sents.en: The skills{} catalog describes reusable procedures for constructing different parts of the KG, including its usage guide, metrics and business rules, and warehouse and model structure.
sents.zh: skills{} 目录描述了构建 KG 不同部分的可重用流程，包括其使用指南、指标与业务规则，以及仓库和模型结构。

sents.en: Catalog entries contain metadata rather than complete skill bodies.
sents.zh: 目录条目包含元数据，而非完整的技能内容。

sents.en: During execution, assigned agents expand them into runtime_skills/<name>.md .
sents.zh: 在执行过程中，指定的智能体会将其扩展为 runtime_skills/<name>.md。

sents.en: These skills guide KG production and may be shared among agents in the authoring pipeline.
sents.zh: 这些技能指导 KG 的生成，并可在编写流程中的不同智能体之间共享。

paragraphs.en: Agent orchestration. The agents[] list defines an ordered sequence of agent sessions that produce the KG. Each session has an editable prompt and a set of assigned skills. The mutator may rewrite prompts, add or remove agents, split or merge roles, reorder the pipeline, and redistribute skills. The agents share a sanitized workspace. This permits either a single agent or a pipeline with separate exploration, verification, and synthesis roles.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体编排。 agents[] 列表定义了一个有序的智能体会话序列，用于生成知识图谱（KG）。 每个会话都包含一个可编辑的提示词和一组分配的技能。 修改器可以重写提示词、添加或移除智能体、拆分或合并角色、重排流程，并重新分配技能。 这些智能体共享一个经过净化的工作区。 这使得单个智能体或包含独立探索、验证和合成角色的流程成为可能。

sents.en: Agent orchestration.
sents.zh: 智能体编排。

sents.en: The agents[] list defines an ordered sequence of agent sessions that produce the KG.
sents.zh: agents[] 列表定义了一个有序的智能体会话序列，用于生成知识图谱（KG）。

sents.en: Each session has an editable prompt and a set of assigned skills.
sents.zh: 每个会话都包含一个可编辑的提示词和一组分配的技能。

sents.zh: 这使得单个智能体或包含独立探索、验证和合成角色的流程成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Adherence test protocol. A second form of context for the solver agent is executable tests derived from the KG. It is a protocol used during compilation rather than a section of KG.md . A fixed test authoring model consumes the KG together with this evolved protocol and produces test_kg.py . Evolution can therefore improve both the declarative guidance given to the solver and the way that guidance is translated into executable feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循性测试协议。 求解智能体的第二种上下文形式是源自知识图谱的可执行测试。 这是一种在编译期间使用的协议，而不是 KG.md 中的一个部分。 一个固定的测试编写模型会结合使用知识图谱和这个演化后的协议，并生成 test_kg.py。 因此，演化过程既能改进提供给求解器的声明性指导，也能改进将这种指导转化为可执行反馈的方式。

sents.en: Adherence test protocol.
sents.zh: 遵循性测试协议。

sents.en: A second form of context for the solver agent is executable tests derived from the KG.
sents.zh: 求解智能体的第二种上下文形式是源自知识图谱的可执行测试。

sents.zh: 这是一种在编译期间使用的协议，而不是 KG.md 中的一个部分。

sents.zh: 一个固定的测试编写模型会结合使用知识图谱和这个演化后的协议，并生成 test_kg.py。

sents.en: Evolution can therefore improve both the declarative guidance given to the solver and the way that guidance is translated into executable feedback.
sents.zh: 因此，演化过程既能改进提供给求解器的声明性指导，也能改进将这种指导转化为可执行反馈的方式。

paragraphs.en: At inference time, the best evolved program is fixed and its executor materializes the evolved protocols and agent configuration. All evaluated agent roles use the same out-of-the-box claude-sonnet-5 backbone and harness. These roles include the ordered agent sessions that construct the KG and the downstream agent that consumes it before executing a task. Only KG.md is registered as a skill for the Harbor agent. The internal runtime_skills/*.md files are not forwarded.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，最佳演化程序是固定的，其执行器会具体化演化出的协议和智能体配置。 所有经过评估的智能体角色都使用相同的现成 claude-sonnet-5 基础模型和工具集。 这些角色包括按顺序执行、构建知识图谱的智能体会话，以及在执行任务前使用该知识图谱的下游智能体。 只有 KG.md 被注册为 Harbor 智能体的技能。 内部 runtime_skills/*.md 文件不会被转发。

sents.en: At inference time, the best evolved program is fixed and its executor materializes the evolved protocols and agent configuration.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，最佳演化程序是固定的，其执行器会具体化演化出的协议和智能体配置。

sents.en: All evaluated agent roles use the same out-of-the-box claude-sonnet-5 backbone and harness.
sents.zh: 所有经过评估的智能体角色都使用相同的现成 claude-sonnet-5 基础模型和工具集。

sents.en: These roles include the ordered agent sessions that construct the KG and the downstream agent that consumes it before executing a task.
sents.zh: 这些角色包括按顺序执行、构建知识图谱的智能体会话，以及在执行任务前使用该知识图谱的下游智能体。

sents.en: Only KG.md is registered as a skill for the Harbor agent.
sents.zh: 只有 KG.md 被注册为 Harbor 智能体的技能。

sents.en: The internal runtime_skills/*.md files are not forwarded.
sents.zh: 内部 runtime_skills/*.md 文件不会被转发。

paragraphs.en: The sole model exception is the fixed adherence test author, which uses claude-opus-4-8 with temperature 0.2 0.2 and a completion limit of 50,000 tokens. It translates KG.md and the evolved adherence test authoring protocol into test_kg.py . We hard pin this model because claude-sonnet-5 frequently produced truncated or syntactically invalid long test suites, particularly unterminated strings. The generated suite is supplied to the Harbor agent as self-correction feedback. It is not the hidden grader, which remains fixed throughout evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一的模型例外是固定遵循性测试作者，该模型使用 claude-opus-4-8，温度设为 0.2 0.2，完成限制为 50,000 个词元。 它将 KG.md 和演化后的遵循性测试编写协议转换为 test_kg.py。 我们固定使用这个模型，因为 claude-sonnet-5 经常生成截断或语法无效的长测试套件，尤其是未终止的字符串。 生成的测试套件作为自我纠正反馈提供给 Harbor 智能体。 它不是隐藏评分器，该评分器在整个评估过程中保持不变。

sents.en: The sole model exception is the fixed adherence test author, which uses claude-opus-4-8 with temperature 0.2 0.2 and a completion limit of 50,000 tokens.
sents.zh: 唯一的模型例外是固定遵循性测试作者，该模型使用 claude-opus-4-8，温度设为 0.2 0.2，完成限制为 50,000 个词元。

sents.en: It translates KG.md and the evolved adherence test authoring protocol into test_kg.py .
sents.zh: 它将 KG.md 和演化后的遵循性测试编写协议转换为 test_kg.py。

sents.en: We hard pin this model because claude-sonnet-5 frequently produced truncated or syntactically invalid long test suites, particularly unterminated strings.
sents.zh: 我们固定使用这个模型，因为 claude-sonnet-5 经常生成截断或语法无效的长测试套件，尤其是未终止的字符串。

sents.en: The generated suite is supplied to the Harbor agent as self-correction feedback.
sents.zh: 生成的测试套件作为自我纠正反馈提供给 Harbor 智能体。

sents.en: It is not the hidden grader, which remains fixed throughout evaluation.
sents.zh: 它不是隐藏评分器，该评分器在整个评估过程中保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We note that adherence tests were generated for these evaluation runs but were not used for all runs. We therefore treat adherence testing as optional additional context rather than a uniform component of the reported results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们注意到，这些评估运行生成了合规性测试，但并非所有运行都使用了这些测试。 因此，我们将合规性测试视为可选的额外上下文，而非报告结果中的统一组成部分。

sents.en: We note that adherence tests were generated for these evaluation runs but were not used for all runs.
sents.zh: 我们注意到，这些评估运行生成了合规性测试，但并非所有运行都使用了这些测试。

sents.en: We therefore treat adherence testing as optional additional context rather than a uniform component of the reported results.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将合规性测试视为可选的额外上下文，而非报告结果中的统一组成部分。

paragraphs.en: The reported CoCoEvolve result uses the best program available after 200 iterations. We configure one island, an active population of 15 candidates, an archive capacity of 8, 8 parallel evaluations, and the P0/P1/P2 evolution graph over the dev pool. We compare against faithful ports of GEPA, Meta-Harness, and AdaEvolve using the same claude-sonnet-5 backbone, downstream agent, equivalent iteration budget, and seed program _PIPELINE_SPEC .
paragraphs.zh: 所报告的 CoCoEvolve 结果使用了经过 200 次迭代后可用的最佳程序。 我们配置了一个岛屿、一个包含 15 个候选者的活跃种群、8 的存档容量、8 次并行评估，以及在开发池中使用的 P0/P1/P2 演化图。 我们使用相同的 claude-sonnet-5 主干模型、下游智能体、等效的迭代预算和种子程序 _PIPELINE_SPEC，与 GEPA、Meta-Harness 和 AdaEvolve 的忠实移植版本进行比较。

sents.en: The reported CoCoEvolve result uses the best program available after 200 iterations.
sents.zh: 所报告的 CoCoEvolve 结果使用了经过 200 次迭代后可用的最佳程序。

sents.en: We configure one island, an active population of 15 candidates, an archive capacity of 8, 8 parallel evaluations, and the P0/P1/P2 evolution graph over the dev pool.
sents.zh: 我们配置了一个岛屿、一个包含 15 个候选者的活跃种群、8 的存档容量、8 次并行评估，以及在开发池中使用的 P0/P1/P2 演化图。

paragraphs.en: The evolved specification p ∗ p^{\ast} retains the initial three seed skills and authors an additional four. Two are pre-exploration environment checks: kg-environment-preflight confirms a usable, authorized warehouse, and kg-dbt-profiles-default-path pins the ~/.dbt/ default so fixes are persisted rather than session-local. The other two are a column-verification protocol requiring DESCRIBE evidence for every named column, and a worked-example protocol for weighted or ratio-based metrics. The kg-adherence-test-author description also tightens, requiring each stated business rule to be checked by live-SQL recomputation against source and banning negative-only assertions. In this example, the initial architect agent is the sole agent; no other agents were spawned.
paragraphs.zh: 演化后的规范 p ∗ p^{\ast} 保留了最初的三项种子技能，并额外生成了四项。 其中两项是探索前的环境检查：kg-environment-preflight 确认仓库可用且已授权，而 kg-dbt-profiles-default-path 则固定了 ~/.dbt/ 默认路径，以确保修改被持久化而非仅限当前会话。 另外两项分别是列验证协议（要求为每个命名的列提供 DESCRIBE 证据）和针对加权或比率类指标的工作示例协议。 kg-adherence-test-author 的描述也进一步收紧，要求对每条明确声明的业务规则通过实时 SQL 重新计算与源数据进行核对，并禁止仅使用否定形式的断言。 在此示例中，初始的架构师智能体是唯一的智能体；没有生成其他任何智能体。

sents.zh: 演化后的规范 p ∗ p^{\ast} 保留了最初的三项种子技能，并额外生成了四项。

sents.en: The kg-adherence-test-author description also tightens, requiring each stated business rule to be checked by live-SQL recomputation against source and banning negative-only assertions.
sents.zh: kg-adherence-test-author 的描述也进一步收紧，要求对每条明确声明的业务规则通过实时 SQL 重新计算与源数据进行核对，并禁止仅使用否定形式的断言。

paragraphs.en: Below is KG.md for task dbt-fix-marketing-attribution , produced by p ∗ p^{\ast} . It records verified tables, columns, data values, and environment settings for the downstream solver agent. It also flags differences between the task instruction and the live warehouse instead of making unsupported assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 以下是任务 dbt-fix-marketing-attribution 的 KG.md，由 p ∗ p^{\ast} 生成。 它记录了下游求解智能体所使用的已验证表、列、数据值和环境设置。 它还会标记任务说明与实时数据仓库之间的差异，而不是做出没有依据的假设。

sents.en: Below is KG.md for task dbt-fix-marketing-attribution , produced by p ∗ p^{\ast} .
sents.zh: 以下是任务 dbt-fix-marketing-attribution 的 KG.md，由 p ∗ p^{\ast} 生成。

sents.en: It records verified tables, columns, data values, and environment settings for the downstream solver agent.
sents.zh: 它记录了下游求解智能体所使用的已验证表、列、数据值和环境设置。

paragraphs.en: The suite below turns KG statements into executable checks. Some tests verify recorded facts against the live data warehouse, while others recompute business rules from source data and compare them with the solver’s output. Their failure messages point the solver to the relevant KG statement, helping it locate and fix mismatches.
paragraphs.zh: 下面这一系列工具能将知识图谱（KG）中的陈述转化为可执行的检查项。 一些测试会核对已记录的事实与实时数据仓库中的数据，而另一些测试则会从源数据重新计算业务规则，并将其与求解器的输出结果进行比较。 它们的失败信息会引导求解器定位到相关的知识图谱（KG）陈述，从而帮助其发现并修正不匹配之处。

sents.en: The suite below turns KG statements into executable checks.
sents.zh: 下面这一系列工具能将知识图谱（KG）中的陈述转化为可执行的检查项。

sents.en: Some tests verify recorded facts against the live data warehouse, while others recompute business rules from source data and compare them with the solver’s output.
sents.zh: 一些测试会核对已记录的事实与实时数据仓库中的数据，而另一些测试则会从源数据重新计算业务规则，并将其与求解器的输出结果进行比较。

paragraphs.en: All math and ADRS runs share a 100-iteration budget and a matched backbone ( claude-sonnet-5 or openai-gpt-5.6-terra ). AdaEvolve, OpenEvolve, and GEPA mutate through a stateless completion; CoCoEvolve uses the agentic loop of Appendix C.1 , skipping the InfoGain branch because these tasks have no instance pool. The AdaEvolve row in Table 4 reruns AdaEvolve’s control loop with the same backbone model as CoCoEvolve. Matching the backbone removes model choice as an explanation for the observed gap between these search setups. We report the best objective reached within the shared budget.
paragraphs.zh: 所有数学和 ADRS 运行都共享 100 次迭代的预算和一个匹配的骨干模型（claude-sonnet-5 或 openai-gpt-5.6-terra）。 AdaEvolve、OpenEvolve 和 GEPA 通过无状态完成进行变异；CoCoEvolve 使用附录 C.1 中的智能体循环，并跳过 InfoGain 分支，因为这些任务没有实例池。 表 4 中 AdaEvolve 那一行重新运行了 AdaEvolve 的控制循环，并使用与 CoCoEvolve 相同的骨干模型。 匹配骨干模型消除了模型选择作为这些搜索设置之间观察到的差异的解释。 我们报告了在共享预算内达到的最佳目标值。

sents.en: All math and ADRS runs share a 100-iteration budget and a matched backbone ( claude-sonnet-5 or openai-gpt-5.6-terra ).
sents.zh: 所有数学和 ADRS 运行都共享 100 次迭代的预算和一个匹配的骨干模型（claude-sonnet-5 或 openai-gpt-5.6-terra）。

sents.en: The AdaEvolve row in Table 4 reruns AdaEvolve’s control loop with the same backbone model as CoCoEvolve.
sents.zh: 表 4 中 AdaEvolve 那一行重新运行了 AdaEvolve 的控制循环，并使用与 CoCoEvolve 相同的骨干模型。

sents.zh: 匹配骨干模型消除了模型选择作为这些搜索设置之间观察到的差异的解释。

sents.en: We report the best objective reached within the shared budget.
sents.zh: 我们报告了在共享预算内达到的最佳目标值。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 records the instance size, the scalar reported in the main tables, and the Human/SOTA source. Higher is better except Cloudcast, which reports total broadcast cost.

paragraphs.en: Surprisingly, AdaEvolve and CoCoEvolve independently converge to essentially the same champion strategy: both fit the complete signal with an L1 data term and an L1 second-difference penalty, expressed as the same sparse linear program, and return the aligned tail of the resulting piecewise-linear trend. Their material difference is only how the regularization weight is chosen. CoCoEvolve scales a fixed coefficient by a robust noise estimate, whereas AdaEvolve uses a clipped noise-to-motion rule. In the reported exchange experiment, swapping the regularization rules also swaps the measured performance. The two champions therefore share the same broad filtering approach, and the regularization rule appears to explain their score difference in this comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 令人惊讶的是，AdaEvolve 和 CoCoEvolve 各自独立地收敛到了几乎完全相同的冠军策略：两者都使用 L1 数据项和 L1 二阶差分惩罚项来拟合完整信号，这可以表示为同一个稀疏线性规划问题，并返回由此得到的分段线性趋势中经过对齐的尾部部分。 它们唯一的实质性区别仅在于正则化权重的选择方式。 CoCoEvolve 通过一个稳健的噪声估计值来缩放一个固定系数，而 AdaEvolve 则使用一个截断的噪声与运动比规则。 在报告的对换实验中，交换正则化规则也会导致测得的性能发生相应变化。 因此，这两种冠军策略共享了相同的宽泛过滤方法，而正则化规则似乎可以解释它们在此次比较中的得分差异。

sents.zh: 令人惊讶的是，AdaEvolve 和 CoCoEvolve 各自独立地收敛到了几乎完全相同的冠军策略：两者都使用 L1 数据项和 L1 二阶差分惩罚项来拟合完整信号，这可以表示为同一个稀疏线性规划问题，并返回由此得到的分段线性趋势中经过对齐的尾部部分。

sents.en: Their material difference is only how the regularization weight is chosen.
sents.zh: 它们唯一的实质性区别仅在于正则化权重的选择方式。

sents.en: CoCoEvolve scales a fixed coefficient by a robust noise estimate, whereas AdaEvolve uses a clipped noise-to-motion rule.
sents.zh: CoCoEvolve 通过一个稳健的噪声估计值来缩放一个固定系数，而 AdaEvolve 则使用一个截断的噪声与运动比规则。

sents.en: In the reported exchange experiment, swapping the regularization rules also swaps the measured performance.
sents.zh: 在报告的对换实验中，交换正则化规则也会导致测得的性能发生相应变化。

sents.en: The two champions therefore share the same broad filtering approach, and the regularization rule appears to explain their score difference in this comparison.

paragraphs.zh: 在两种骨干网络中，当 Avg 和 Best 被单独计算时，CoCoEvolve 在 24 个数学单元中有 13 个表现最佳或并列最佳，在 20 个 ADRS 单元中有 12 个表现最佳或并列最佳。 总体而言，它在 44 个单元中领先了 25 个，而 GEPA 为 18 个，AdaEvolve 为 13 个，OpenEvolve 为 6 个。

paragraphs.en: The dotted trial is the CMA-ES recovery and contributes to the three-run Avg. Its first rewrite scores 0.0234 0.0234 and stalls near 0.0281 0.0281 from iteration 31 31 while the mutator retries SciPy global solvers. At iteration 75 75 , the reflector marks that family as exhausted and proposes a NumPy CMA-ES. A scratch prototype reaches 0.03035 0.03035 at iteration 78 78 . At iteration 89 89 , the mutator returns to a dual-annealing program from iteration 19 19 , which scored 0.02648 0.02648 , rather than using the current best CMA-ES child. It queries the ranked archive and adds CMA-ES with an exact-bilinear SLP polish, producing the 0.03078 0.03078 champion.
paragraphs.zh: 带点的试验是 CMA-ES 恢复过程，并贡献于三次运行的平均值。 其首次重写的得分为 0.0234 0.0234，并在迭代 31 31 时停滞在 0.0281 0.0281 附近，同时变异器重新尝试 SciPy 全局求解器。 在迭代 75 75 时，反射器将该族标记为已耗尽，并提议使用 NumPy CMA-ES。 一个临时原型在迭代 78 78 时达到了 0.03035 0.03035。 在迭代 89 89 时，变异器回到了迭代 19 19 时的双退火程序（该程序得分为 0.02648 0.02648），而不是使用当前的最佳 CMA-ES 子代。 它查询了排序后的存档，并加入了带有精确双线性 SLP 优化的 CMA-ES，从而产生了得分为 0.03078 0.03078 的冠军方案。

paragraphs.en: Either recovery is load-bearing for the Avg win. If the CMA-ES trial had remained at 0.0281 0.0281 and the Tutte trial at its pre-jump 0.0275 0.0275 , the three-run mean would be 0.0289 0.0289 , below GEPA. If only one of the two recovered, the mean would still sit near 0.0297 0.0297 . Heilbronn therefore shows how historical synthesis improves reliability near a ceiling. The ledger triggers a new family after a stall, and the archive query transfers that family to a viable island. This mechanism explains the high Avg rather than a uniquely high Best.
paragraphs.zh: 要么恢复过程对平均胜率具有承载作用。 如果 CMA-ES 试验保持在 0.0281 0.0281，而 Tutte 试验则处于跳跃前的 0.0275 0.0275，那么三轮均值将为 0.0289 0.0289，低于 GEPA。 如果两者中只有一个恢复，均值仍将接近 0.0297 0.0297。 因此，Heilbronn 展示了历史综合方法如何提升在接近上限时的可靠性。 账本在停滞后会触发一个新的家族，而档案查询则将该家族转移到一个可行的岛屿上。 这一机制解释了为何平均胜率较高，而非最佳胜率独一无二地高。

paragraphs.en: This is a saturation control, not a CoCoEvolve win. Once every method can hit the ceiling, the remaining signal is how the shared budget is spent getting there. On the traces in Figure 7 , GEPA is first (iteration 8 8 ), CoCoEvolve is second (iteration 24 24 ), AdaEvolve reaches the ceiling at iteration 91 91 , and OpenEvolve is still at 2.6298 2.6298 at iteration 100 100 (its Best of 2.63598 2.63598 is from iteration 111 111 , outside the shared window). We do not read first-to-ceiling as a method ranking: GEPA winning that race on a saturated packing instance is compatible with Heilbronn, where the same protocol separates the methods on Avg rather than Best.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种饱和控制，而非 CoCoEvolve 的胜利。 一旦所有方法都能达到上限，剩下的关键信号就是共享预算如何被用于实现这一目标。 在图 7 的轨迹中，GEPA 排名第一（迭代 8 8），CoCoEvolve 排名第二（迭代 24 24），AdaEvolve 在第 91 91 次迭代时达到上限，而 OpenEvolve 在第 100 100 次迭代时仍停留在 2.6298 2.6298（其最佳值 2.63598 2.63598 来自第 111 111 次迭代，超出了共享窗口）。 我们将“最先达到上限”的结果视为方法排名：GEPA 在饱和打包实例中赢得该竞赛，与 Heilbronn 的情况是兼容的——在 Heilbronn 中，同一协议是根据平均表现而非最佳表现来区分这些方法的。

paragraphs.en: The objective is the simulator’s true union-of-edges cost of a multi-cloud broadcast tree (lower is better); Human/SOTA is 626.2 626.2 . The seed enumerates Azure single- and two-hub plans ranked by a node-count/bottleneck proxy, with an arborescence fallback, and scores 974 974 . The analysis below is the CoCoEvolve Best-cell Sonnet-5 run under the same 100 100 -iteration protocol. OpenEvolve remains far from the others; GEPA, AdaEvolve, and CoCoEvolve all finish in a tight 618 618 cluster (Table 4 ), so this subsection is about the construction that reached that cluster, not about ranking inside it.
paragraphs.zh: 目标在于模拟器的多云广播树的真实边联合成本（数值越低越好）；人类/SOTA 的成绩为 626.2 626.2。 种子枚举了按节点数/瓶颈代理指标排序的 Azure 单枢纽和双枢纽方案，并设有树形结构备用方案，得分为 974 974。 以下分析是 CoCoEvolve 最佳单元 Sonnet-5 在相同 100 100 次迭代协议下的运行结果。 OpenEvolve 与其他方案仍有较大差距；GEPA、AdaEvolve 和 CoCoEvolve 的成绩均集中在 618 618 这一紧密区间（表 4），因此本小节将讨论达到该成绩区间的具体构建方法，而非区间内的排名比较。

paragraphs.en: The champion no longer searches only for hubs. It evaluates six structurally distinct tree families: terminal MSA, relay hub, capacitated min-cost flow, Dreyfus–Wagner DP, resistance ranking, and TSP relay. A proxy replays the simulator’s cost model and selects the cheapest candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 冠军不再仅仅搜索枢纽。 它评估六种结构上不同的树族：终端 MSA、中继枢纽、容量最小成本流、Dreyfus–Wagner DP、电阻排名和 TSP 中继。 代理会重演模拟器的成本模型，并选择最便宜的候选项。

sents.zh: 代理会重演模拟器的成本模型，并选择最便宜的候选项。

paragraphs.en: The first two iterations reduce cost from 974 974 to 636 636 by reading the cost graph and instance configuration and by testing scratch candidates against the live evaluator. Later cross-lineage grafts add Dreyfus–Wagner ranking and a TSP-relay construction, which produce the remaining improvement. The trace documents a substantial rewrite of the seed’s search procedure. Because GEPA, AdaEvolve, and CoCoEvolve finish close together, Cloudcast gives little evidence for ranking their final scores. TXN provides a clearer example of a large score change after a structural rewrite.
paragraphs.zh: 前两次迭代通过读取成本图与实例配置，并测试临时候选方案在实时评估器上的表现，将成本从 974 974 降低至 636 636。 随后的跨谱系嫁接引入了 Dreyfus–Wagner 排序和 TSP 中继构建方法，从而实现了剩余的改进。 该追踪记录了对初始方案搜索流程的大规模重写过程。 由于 GEPA、AdaEvolve 和 CoCoEvolve 的最终得分非常接近，Cloudcast 提供的证据不足以对它们的最终分数进行排序。 TXN 提供了一个更清晰的例子，展示了结构重写后得分发生巨大变化的情况。

paragraphs.en: The objective is a combined throughput-style score of a lock-aware transaction schedule (higher is better); Human/SOTA is 2,725 2{,}725 . The seed is tabu search over swap and or-opt-1 from Copeland / MDS / assignment-problem / greedy starts, and scores 2,725 2{,}725 . The reported runs show substantial headroom above that seed and reference value. Both the mean and best scores can therefore distinguish methods here. The analysis below is the CoCoEvolve Best-cell Sonnet-5 run that produced 4,348 4{,}348 , under the same 100 100 -iteration protocol.

paragraphs.en: The champion replaces the seed’s tabu loop with a three-stage pipeline. An assignment-problem relaxation and a single-path greedy construction from the top Copeland candidate each build a starting schedule, and the cheaper one is kept; simulated annealing then applies double-bridge reheating, and first-improvement local search performs the final cleanup.
paragraphs.zh: 冠军用三段式流水线取代了种子选手的禁忌循环。 一个分配问题松弛和一个从最高 Copeland 候选者出发的单路径贪心构造各自生成一个初始调度，并保留成本较低的那个；随后模拟退火应用双桥重加热，而首次改进局部搜索则执行最终清理。

sents.en: The champion replaces the seed’s tabu loop with a three-stage pipeline.
sents.zh: 冠军用三段式流水线取代了种子选手的禁忌循环。

paragraphs.en: Copeland ranking and an EDA over pairwise order probabilities first move the score above the seed. The EDA also queries the ranked archive instead of editing only the parent. The final program uses assignment/greedy construction followed by simulated annealing, not a retuned tabu tenure.
paragraphs.zh: 科普兰排序和基于成对顺序概率的 EDA 首先将得分提升至初始值之上。 EDA 还会查询已排序的档案库，而不仅仅是修改父代。 最终程序采用分配/贪心构造法，随后进行模拟退火，而非重新调整禁忌保留期。

paragraphs.en: TXN is therefore the far-from-ceiling counterpart to Heilbronn. In Heilbronn, the ledger improves reliability by rescuing stalled trials. In TXN, the same keep-or-switch loop replaces the seed metaheuristic and improves both Avg and Best beyond the other methods.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，TXN 是海利布龙问题的一个远非天花板级的对应方案。 在海利布龙问题中，账本通过挽救陷入停滞的试验来提高可靠性。 在 TXN 中，相同的“保留或切换”循环取代了种子元启发式方法，并使 Avg 和 Best 的表现都优于其他方法。

sents.en: TXN is therefore the far-from-ceiling counterpart to Heilbronn.
sents.zh: 因此，TXN 是海利布龙问题的一个远非天花板级的对应方案。

sents.zh: 在海利布龙问题中，账本通过挽救陷入停滞的试验来提高可靠性。

sents.en: In TXN, the same keep-or-switch loop replaces the seed metaheuristic and improves both Avg and Best beyond the other methods.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three tasks from GEPA’s benchmark suite. All three compare an unmodified seed, GEPA, and CoCoEvolve from the same initial program; each CoCoEvolve run uses 100 iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 GEPA 基准套件中的三项任务。 这三项任务均比较了未经修改的种子程序、GEPA 以及来自同一初始程序的 CoCoEvolve；每次 CoCoEvolve 运行均使用 100 次迭代。

sents.en: We evaluate three tasks from GEPA’s benchmark suite.
sents.zh: 我们评估了 GEPA 基准套件中的三项任务。

sents.en: All three compare an unmodified seed, GEPA, and CoCoEvolve from the same initial program; each CoCoEvolve run uses 100 iterations.
sents.zh: 这三项任务均比较了未经修改的种子程序、GEPA 以及来自同一初始程序的 CoCoEvolve；每次 CoCoEvolve 运行均使用 100 次迭代。

paragraphs.en: The artifact is a four-stage retrieve-summarize-answer pipeline over a BM25 index of Wikipedia abstracts, with prompts for first-hop summarization ( summarize1 ), second-hop query generation ( create_query_hop2 ), second-hop summarization ( summarize2 ), and final answering ( final_answer ). Each mutation changes one prompt while retrieval remains fixed, and GEPA’s round-robin selector mutates the same four components in the same cycle. We use GEPA’s official 150/300/300 train, validation, and held-out-test split. The GEPA search budgets were chosen to be broadly comparable to the 100-iteration CoCoEvolve runs, although the two methods account for evaluations differently. The frozen Sonnet-5 backbone serves as both mutator and student.
paragraphs.zh: 该人工制品是一个四阶段的“检索-摘要-回答”流程，基于维基百科摘要的 BM25 索引，并包含第一跳摘要（summarize1）、第二跳查询生成（create_query_hop2）、第二跳摘要（summarize2）以及最终回答（final_answer）的提示。 每次突变仅改变一个提示，而检索部分保持不变；GEPA 的循环选择器在同一周期内对相同的四个组件进行突变。 我们使用 GEPA 官方的 150/300/300 训练集、验证集和预留测试集划分方案。 GEPA 的搜索预算被设定为与 CoCoEvolve 的 100 次迭代运行大致相当，尽管这两种方法对评估的考量方式不同。 冻结的 Sonnet-5 骨干模型同时充当突变器和学生模型。

paragraphs.en: GEPA uses the same Benchmark base class for AIME, HotpotQA, and IFBench. The artifact runner passes individual query instances in separate training and validation sets for all three tasks. GEPA samples three training examples by default for each reflective step. A proposed edit must strictly improve its parent’s score on that minibatch. Each accepted candidate then triggers a full validation-set evaluation, whose per-example scores inform the Pareto selector’s choice of future parents.
paragraphs.zh: GEPA 对 AIME、HotpotQA 和 IFBench 都使用相同的基准基类。 该工具运行器为所有三项任务分别传递训练集和验证集中的单个查询实例。 GEPA 默认在每个反思步骤中采样三个训练示例。 任何提议的编辑都必须严格提升其父项在该小批量上的得分。 每个被接受的候选项随后会触发对整个验证集的评估，其中每个示例的得分将指导帕累托选择器决定未来的父项。

paragraphs.en: The evolved artifact is a single chain-of-thought system prompt that a frozen student model reads with each competition math problem to produce an integer answer. GEPA’s fixed-seed split draws 45 training and 45 validation problems from AI-MO/aimo-validation-aime ; its disjoint test set contains 30 problems from MathArena/aime_2025 . AIME uses openai-gpt-5.6-luna as both mutator and student. An initial Sonnet-5 run gave the seed a perfect training score, leaving no signal for optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 演化后的产物是一个单链式思维系统提示，一个冻结的学生模型在解决每道竞赛数学题时都会读取该提示，以生成一个整数答案。 GEPA 的固定种子划分从 AI-MO/aimo-validation-aime 中抽取了 45 个训练问题和 45 个验证问题；其互斥的测试集包含来自 MathArena/aime_2025 的 30 个问题。 AIME 同时使用 openai-gpt-5.6-luna 作为变异器和学生模型。 最初的一次 Sonnet-5 运行使该种子获得了完美的训练分数，导致没有优化信号。

paragraphs.en: The artifact has two prompt-driven stages, generate_response and ensure_correct_response . The evaluator scores the fraction of each query’s instruction constraints that the response satisfies. It supports 83 checker types: 25 from IFEval and 58 IFBench-native types, including word and letter counts, formatting, and keyword use. Eight leniency variants account for markdown emphasis and optional leading or trailing lines. Neither stage sees the constraint list. GEPA’s fixed split uses the first 300 rows of its training file for validation and samples 150 training rows from the next 300 with a fixed seed. We use its bundled 294-row test file unchanged; it has six fewer rows than the public IFBench release. IFBench also uses openai-gpt-5.6-luna as both mutator and student.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具包含两个由提示驱动的阶段：generate_response 和 ensure_correct_response。 评估器会评分每个查询的指令约束条件中，响应所满足的部分比例。 它支持 83 种检查类型：其中 25 种来自 IFEval，58 种为 IFBench 原生类型，包括单词和字母计数、格式以及关键词使用等。 八种宽松变体考虑了 Markdown 强调格式以及可选的开头或结尾行。 这两个阶段都不会看到约束条件列表。 GEPA 的固定划分方案使用其训练文件中的前 300 行作为验证集，并从接下来的 300 行中按固定种子随机抽取 150 行训练数据。 我们直接使用其附带的包含 294 行的测试文件；该文件比公开的 IFBench 版本少六行。 IFBench 也将 openai-gpt-5.6-luna 同时用作变异器和学生模型。

paragraphs.en: With openai-gpt-5.6-luna , we evaluated the same evolved AIME prompt twice on the 45 training problems: once during optimization and once afterward. The second evaluation got five fewer answers correct, even though the prompt had not changed. The student’s nonzero decoding temperature can make its answers vary between evaluations. Each optimizer ran once and produced one final candidate. We evaluated that unchanged candidate three times on each AIME and IFBench split and report the mean and standard deviation in Table 5 . These repeats measure evaluation variability, not search variability. On AIME test, five baseline questions, eight GEPA questions, and six CoCoEvolve questions changed correctness across repeats, even though the baseline’s aggregate test score was 25 / 30 25/30 every time.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 openai-gpt-5.6-luna，我们对相同的进化 AIME 提示在 45 个训练问题上进行了两次评估：一次是在优化过程中，另一次是在之后。 第二次评估的正确答案少了五个，尽管提示本身并未改变。 学生的非零解码温度可能导致其答案在不同评估中有所差异。 每个优化器仅运行一次，并生成一个最终候选方案。 我们对每个未改变的候选方案在 AIME 和 IFBench 的每个分集上进行了三次评估，并在表 5 中报告了平均值和标准差。 这些重复评估衡量的是评估的变异性，而非搜索的变异性。 在 AIME 测试中，五个基准问题、八个 GEPA 问题和六个 CoCoEvolve 问题的正确性在不同重复评估中发生了变化，尽管基准的总测试分数每次都是 25/30。

paragraphs.en: The HotpotQA run of Appendix J.1 scores its entire 150 150 -question training pool and 300 300 -question validation pool on every one of its 100 100 iterations, unconditionally – 450 450 real model-backed questions per iteration regardless of how informative any single one is. DABStep’s own evaluator (Appendix C.2 , Appendix C.3 ) instead scores only a bounded, informativeness-targeted subset per iteration and extrapolates the rest from the parent’s own history. We test a HotpotQA variant that combines similarity-based target selection, P0/P1/P2 cascaded evaluation, and mutator self-testing. The comparison measures this combined configuration. It cannot attribute any score or time difference to one of the three changes alone.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 J.1 中的 HotpotQA 运行会在其全部 100 次迭代中，无条件地对整个包含 150 个问题的训练集和 300 个问题的验证集进行评分——每次迭代都会处理 450 个由真实模型支持的问题，无论单个问题能提供多少信息。 相比之下，DABStep 自身的评估器（附录 C.2、附录 C.3）在每次迭代中仅对有限且以信息量为目标的子集进行评分，并从父模型自身的历史记录中推断其余部分。 我们测试了一种 HotpotQA 变体，该变体结合了基于相似性的目标选择、P0/P1/P2 级联评估以及突变器自我测试。 该比较衡量了这一组合配置的表现。 它无法将任何分数或时间差异归因于这三个改动中的某一个单独作用。

paragraphs.en: Target selection. A similarity graph and InfoGain selector operate over the 150-question training pool (Appendix C.3 ). Each mutation receives one selected focus question instead of the full undifferentiated pool.
paragraphs.zh: 目标选择。 一个相似性图和 InfoGain 选择器在包含 150 道题的训练集（附录 C.3）上运行。 每次变异都会收到一个选定的焦点问题，而不是整个未区分的问题池。

sents.zh: 目标选择。

sents.zh: 一个相似性图和 InfoGain 选择器在包含 150 道题的训练集（附录 C.3）上运行。

paragraphs.en: Cascaded evaluation. The P0/P1/P2 cascade mirrors the DABStep evaluator (Appendix F.1 ). P0 evaluates only the selected target and requires a score of 0.6 0.6 . If P0 passes, P1 evaluates a stratified sample of 20 regression questions, or about 13 % 13\% of the pool. One third of this sample is selected by similarity-weighted risk to the target, and two thirds are sampled uniformly from the parent’s tested history. P1 requires at least 0.9 × 0.9\times the parent’s score on the same sample. If P1 passes, P2 explores similarity-ranked frontier tiers of 10 questions each. One random scout represents each tier, and the next tier opens only if the current tier scores at least 6 / 10 6/10 . The training cascade evaluates at most ⌊ 150 / 3 ⌋ = 50 \lfloor 150/3\rfloor{=}50 questions per iteration, excluding the one-time seed bootstrap, mutator self-tests, and separately sampled validation passes. When the parent is already at ceiling on the target, a live pretest can bypass P0 and P1 and proceed directly to P2.
paragraphs.zh: 级联评估。 P0/P1/P2 级联流程与 DABStep 评估器（附录 F.1）一致。 P0 仅评估选定的目标，且要求得分达到 0.6。 若 P0 通过，P1 将评估一个分层样本，包含 20 道回归问题，约占问题池的 13%（13\%）。 该样本中三分之一的问题根据与目标的相似性加权风险进行选择，其余三分之二则从父智能体的历史测试记录中均匀采样。 P1 要求在同一样本上的得分至少达到父智能体得分的 0.9 倍（0.9\times）。 若 P1 通过，P2 将探索按相似性排序的前沿层级，每层包含 10 个问题。 每个层级由一个随机侦察问题代表，且仅当当前层级得分至少为 6/10（6/10）时，才会开启下一层级。 训练级联流程每次迭代最多评估 ⌊ 150 / 3 ⌋ = 50（\lfloor 150/3\rfloor{=}50）个问题，不包括一次性种子引导、变异体自测以及单独采样的验证流程。 当父智能体在目标上的表现已达到上限时，可通过实时预测试跳过 P0 和 P1，直接进入 P2。

sents.en: P1 requires at least 0.9 × 0.9\times the parent’s score on the same sample.
sents.zh: P1 要求在同一样本上的得分至少达到父智能体得分的 0.9 倍（0.9\times）。

sents.en: If P1 passes, P2 explores similarity-ranked frontier tiers of 10 questions each.
sents.zh: 若 P1 通过，P2 将探索按相似性排序的前沿层级，每层包含 10 个问题。

sents.en: One random scout represents each tier, and the next tier opens only if the current tier scores at least 6 / 10 6/10 .
sents.zh: 每个层级由一个随机侦察问题代表，且仅当当前层级得分至少为 6/10（6/10）时，才会开启下一层级。

sents.en: The training cascade evaluates at most ⌊ 150 / 3 ⌋ = 50 \lfloor 150/3\rfloor{=}50 questions per iteration, excluding the one-time seed bootstrap, mutator self-tests, and separately sampled validation passes.
sents.zh: 训练级联流程每次迭代最多评估 ⌊ 150 / 3 ⌋ = 50（\lfloor 150/3\rfloor{=}50）个问题，不包括一次性种子引导、变异体自测以及单独采样的验证流程。

sents.en: When the parent is already at ceiling on the target, a live pretest can bypass P0 and P1 and proceed directly to P2.
sents.zh: 当父智能体在目标上的表现已达到上限时，可通过实时预测试跳过 P0 和 P1，直接进入 P2。

paragraphs.en: The child’s score combines its updated per-question record with the parent’s inherited record and divides the total by 150. We do not use DABStep’s additive formula because that formula assumes sparse initial coverage. HotpotQA has dense coverage from the seed’s full-pool bootstrap, so the additive formula would double-count observations.
paragraphs.zh: 该儿童的得分将其每道题目的更新记录与家长的继承记录相结合，然后将总和除以 150。 我们不使用 DABStep 的加法公式，因为该公式假设初始覆盖稀疏。 HotpotQA 通过种子完整池的引导实现了密集覆盖，因此使用加法公式会导致观察结果被重复计算。

sents.en: The child’s score combines its updated per-question record with the parent’s inherited record and divides the total by 150.
sents.zh: 该儿童的得分将其每道题目的更新记录与家长的继承记录相结合，然后将总和除以 150。

sents.en: We do not use DABStep’s additive formula because that formula assumes sparse initial coverage.
sents.zh: 我们不使用 DABStep 的加法公式，因为该公式假设初始覆盖稀疏。

sents.en: HotpotQA has dense coverage from the seed’s full-pool bootstrap, so the additive formula would double-count observations.
sents.zh: HotpotQA 通过种子完整池的引导实现了密集覆盖，因此使用加法公式会导致观察结果被重复计算。

paragraphs.en: Mutator self-test. The mutator receives test_draft , with a budget of three calls per turn. It can score an in-progress edit directly on the selected focus question. The mutator prompt also instructs the model to verify its draft before finishing. Both features reproduce DABStep’s self-verification affordance (Appendix C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 变异器自我测试。 变异器接收 test_draft，每轮预算为三次调用。 它可以直接对正在进行的编辑在选定的焦点问题上进行评分。 变异器提示还指示模型在完成前验证其草稿。 这两个功能都再现了 DABStep 的自我验证能力（附录 C.2）。

sents.en: Mutator self-test.
sents.zh: 变异器自我测试。

sents.en: The mutator receives test_draft , with a budget of three calls per turn.
sents.zh: 变异器接收 test_draft，每轮预算为三次调用。

sents.en: It can score an in-progress edit directly on the selected focus question.
sents.zh: 它可以直接对正在进行的编辑在选定的焦点问题上进行评分。

sents.en: The mutator prompt also instructs the model to verify its draft before finishing.
sents.zh: 变异器提示还指示模型在完成前验证其草稿。

sents.en: Both features reproduce DABStep’s self-verification affordance (Appendix C.2 ).
sents.zh: 这两个功能都再现了 DABStep 的自我验证能力（附录 C.2）。

paragraphs.en: Validation is sampled independently with probability 0.1 0.1 per iteration. When validation is skipped, the child inherits the parent’s validation score and per-question record unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 每次迭代中，验证数据以 0.1 的概率独立采样。 当跳过验证时，子智能体将继承父智能体的验证分数和每道题目的记录，且保持不变。

sents.en: Validation is sampled independently with probability 0.1 0.1 per iteration.
sents.zh: 每次迭代中，验证数据以 0.1 的概率独立采样。

sents.en: When validation is skipped, the child inherits the parent’s validation score and per-question record unchanged.
sents.zh: 当跳过验证时，子智能体将继承父智能体的验证分数和每道题目的记录，且保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Across 100 iterations, the cascaded evaluator has a median wall-clock time of 121 121 s per iteration. A full 450-question pass at the same concurrency takes roughly 900 900 – 1100 1100 s. The seed’s one-time full-pool bootstrap takes 1115 1115 s, which is consistent with that estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 在 100 次迭代中，级联评估器每次迭代的实际运行时间中位数为 121 121 秒。 以相同的并发度完整处理 450 个问题大约需要 900 900 – 1100 1100 秒。 种子的一次性完整池启动需要 1115 1115 秒，这与该估算值一致。

sents.en: Across 100 iterations, the cascaded evaluator has a median wall-clock time of 121 121 s per iteration.
sents.zh: 在 100 次迭代中，级联评估器每次迭代的实际运行时间中位数为 121 121 秒。

sents.en: A full 450-question pass at the same concurrency takes roughly 900 900 – 1100 1100 s.
sents.zh: 以相同的并发度完整处理 450 个问题大约需要 900 900 – 1100 1100 秒。

sents.en: The seed’s one-time full-pool bootstrap takes 1115 1115 s, which is consistent with that estimate.
sents.zh: 种子的一次性完整池启动需要 1115 1115 秒，这与该估算值一致。

paragraphs.en: In the first 50 logged iterations, seven ( 14 % 14\% ) took 400 400 – 1100 1100 s; one was the seed bootstrap, and the others included a sampled pass over all 300 validation questions. Extrapolating that mix to 100 iterations gives an estimated 5.5 5.5 – 6 6 hours of evaluator time, versus an estimated 25 25 – 30 30 hours for full-pool evaluation at every iteration. The implied reduction is about 4 4 – 5 × 5\times . These are estimates from the observed timing mix, not measured total run times.
paragraphs.zh: 在最初记录的 50 次迭代中，有 7 次（14%）耗时 400–1100 秒；其中 1 次是种子引导步骤，其余几次则包括对所有 300 道验证问题的抽样处理。 若将这一混合模式外推至 100 次迭代，预计评估者所需时间为 5.5–6 小时，而每次迭代进行全面池评估的预计时间则为 25–30 小时。 由此推断出的效率提升约为 4–5 倍。 这些估算基于观察到的时间分配情况，而非实际测量的总运行时间。

sents.en: In the first 50 logged iterations, seven ( 14 % 14\% ) took 400 400 – 1100 1100 s; one was the seed bootstrap, and the others included a sampled pass over all 300 validation questions.
sents.zh: 在最初记录的 50 次迭代中，有 7 次（14%）耗时 400–1100 秒；其中 1 次是种子引导步骤，其余几次则包括对所有 300 道验证问题的抽样处理。

sents.en: Extrapolating that mix to 100 iterations gives an estimated 5.5 5.5 – 6 6 hours of evaluator time, versus an estimated 25 25 – 30 30 hours for full-pool evaluation at every iteration.
sents.zh: 若将这一混合模式外推至 100 次迭代，预计评估者所需时间为 5.5–6 小时，而每次迭代进行全面池评估的预计时间则为 25–30 小时。

sents.en: The implied reduction is about 4 4 – 5 × 5\times .
sents.zh: 由此推断出的效率提升约为 4–5 倍。

sents.en: These are estimates from the observed timing mix, not measured total run times.
sents.zh: 这些估算基于观察到的时间分配情况，而非实际测量的总运行时间。

paragraphs.en: The combined variant matches the full-pool run’s observed train accuracy ( 0.800 0.800 ) and has 0.007 0.007 higher validation accuracy, but its test accuracy is 0.026 0.026 lower, about eight questions out of 300. The timing estimate suggests lower evaluator cost. With one search and one final re-score per variant, the result does not establish equal held-out quality or isolate which added mechanism produced the difference. It also does not replace or improve the main HotpotQA result in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 该组合变体与全池运行所观察到的训练准确率（0.800 0.800）一致，且验证准确率高出 0.007 0.007，但其测试准确率低了 0.026 0.026，相当于 300 道题中约有八道题的差异。 时间估计表明评估者的成本更低。 对于每个变体仅进行一次搜索和一次最终重新评分，该结果并未证明其保留集质量相等，也未明确是哪种附加机制导致了差异。 它也没有替代或改进表 5 中的主要 HotpotQA 结果。

sents.en: The combined variant matches the full-pool run’s observed train accuracy ( 0.800 0.800 ) and has 0.007 0.007 higher validation accuracy, but its test accuracy is 0.026 0.026 lower, about eight questions out of 300.
sents.zh: 该组合变体与全池运行所观察到的训练准确率（0.800 0.800）一致，且验证准确率高出 0.007 0.007，但其测试准确率低了 0.026 0.026，相当于 300 道题中约有八道题的差异。

sents.en: The timing estimate suggests lower evaluator cost.
sents.zh: 时间估计表明评估者的成本更低。

sents.en: With one search and one final re-score per variant, the result does not establish equal held-out quality or isolate which added mechanism produced the difference.
sents.zh: 对于每个变体仅进行一次搜索和一次最终重新评分，该结果并未证明其保留集质量相等，也未明确是哪种附加机制导致了差异。

sents.en: It also does not replace or improve the main HotpotQA result in Table 5 .
sents.zh: 它也没有替代或改进表 5 中的主要 HotpotQA 结果。
